articleTitle: Web-Based Education Resources Management under Informationized Environment of Education
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Web-based education resources management should take the needs of learners as the prerequisite, take the outstanding management theory as a guide, and take advanced information technology as a support, following the technological specification published by the government, and achieves rational utilization and management of resources. The paper expounds the present situation and the existing problems of Web-based education resources management, and puts forward the corresponding solutions based on analyzing the nature of the problems.

articleTitle: A 3D-Based Positioning Model and Algorithm in Ad Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: In ad hoc network, localization of node is very important and valuable it is also an important technology in the Internet of things. We present an improved localization model 3D-positioning model in ad hoc network (3D-PMAHN) based on Simic's 2D-localization model in ad hoc networks. In 3D-PMAHN, space grid is presented. When one tag in ad hoc networks is detected by certain readers whose positions are known before, the tag's position can be known through calculation. Simulation shows that the localization speed and precision are relatively fast and high.

articleTitle: Related Issues of Power System Visualization
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Several related issues of power system visualization - input of view, collaboration of views and layout of view are presented. The design requirements of input of view include high efficiency, high accuracy and doing not affect the output side. Moreover, intelligent navigation and positioning, and introducing the new input technologies are presented as two methods for improving the input side. Coordination of views aims at allowing the operators control several views by just operating one view. Besides several typical coordination methods, object correlation and information correlation are two specific methods for power system visualization. Layout of view mainly involves how to choose the contents of each screen and how to arrange the multi-screen. The main layout principles are listed at last.

articleTitle: An Engineering Approach for Bayes Reliability Assessment of Avionic Device
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: This paper studies the computation problem of Bayesian method in reliability assessment of avionic device, an engineering approach for Bayesian reliability analysis in the 2-parameter Weibull distribution is proposed to the issue. The prior distribution of failure probability is built according to the engineering experiences, based on the distribution, this approach allows constructing the joint prior distribution of Weibull parameters through random sampling as well as ascertaining the prior estimates of the mean and standard deviation at any given point, then random sampling is adopted again to obtain the joint posterior distribution of the parameters. A practical example is given as an illustration. Result shows that, this approach can simplify computation in practical applications, and it provides great reference values for later use.

articleTitle: A New Feature Extraction Method of Intrusion Detection
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: The paper uses kernel principal component analysis to extract features from the intrusion detection training samples. The method extracts features and reduces the dimensions very effectively. In addition, we make use of RSVM method into nonlinear proximal SVM. It can reduce the computation requirements of the kernel matrix. The combination of the above two methods improve the training speed and classification effect.

articleTitle: A VoIP-based Dynamic Password Distribution Scheme
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: A VoIP-based dynamic password distribution scheme is described in this paper. For the respective drawbacks of the conventional dynamic password distribution schemes, a novel solution is proposed, the dynamic password is obtained by the user through making a call. The distribution system is based on a VoIP subsystem, of which the call control is modified to reduce the cost. The VoIP subsystem is designed on the basis of asterisk and SIP protocol, both of which have outstanding advantages such as expansibility, business-oriented and so on. The architecture, workflow implementation and application of the dynamic password distribution system will be discussed in this paper.

articleTitle: Research and Design of Dynamic Run-Time Database of Atmosphere
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Simulation of atmosphere environment is an important part of high-fidelity distributed battlefield simulation. The simulation applications of atmosphere need to establish dynamic run-time databases to response atmosphere data requests of other weapon realities in time. Technologies of main memory database (MMDB) can be used to meet the needs of real-time quality. In this paper, a dynamic run-time database of atmosphere is implemented based on eXtremeDB which is a commercial main memory database product, and a federate of atmosphere is designed.

articleTitle: The Influencing Factors of Group Learning: An Analysis
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to explore which factors influence group learning content, and content analysis is chosen as the research method. The sample for this study is the literature on group learning. 35 books and 1 paper are examined. The coding system for the content analysis is an opened and a self-expanded system in this study, which means that the original coding system can be updated if the new coding item is developed during the data collection. A total of 62 influencing factors are identified in terms of the content analysis. In order to organise them systematically, we categorised them into four aggregations according to one model of the group learning processes: planning, organising, learning process, and evaluation. The result of this study may be used to design a questionnaire and to model group learning process in our further research.

articleTitle: Chaotic Properties of a Model of an Exchange Economy
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: The paper develops an exchange model involving two individuals and two goods and shows it exhibits Li-Yorke chaos with k isin Delta =(3.0,3.6). The purpose of this paper is to provide another method to prove the model be not chaotic when k isin Delta =[1,1.25]; and exhibits topological chaos, distributional chaos, w-chaos, Devaney-chaos, Li-Yorke chaos and distributional chaos in a sequence with k isin Delta =(2.78,4).

articleTitle: Applications of Computer in Engineering Especially in Electrolysis Magnesium Industry
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: In modern times, computers have closely connection with everyone, especially scientist and engineer. Computer programs can now solve difficult problems in a fraction of the time it used to take. Computer-Aided engineering is a powerful tool and necessary for engineering design and manufacture. Nowadays, you no longer have to write your own software programs to use computers effectively. In chemical engineering, a lot of softwares are used in the process of chemical operation, Such as the software for process of chemical engineering Proiquest and Aspen, and Computational fluid dynamics software Fluent and CFX and so on. The details of the process and unite operation can be investigated by computer and software. During electrolysis magnesium, high temperature and airproofed operation condition prevent the study of fluid phenomena in the electrolytic cell. The computational fluid dynamics can overcome these difficulties. Details of the flow field of electrolytic cell can be visualized on the computer screen. Through the visualization, flow field of electrolytic cell and the factors that affect the electrolysis process can be investigated.

articleTitle: Research on Real-time Localization Algorithm of Aircraft on use of Pilot Signals
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: A 3D passive localization algorithm on the low-altitude aircraft is presented, which takes use of CDMA cellular network pilot signals. The method is using the time differences of arrival (TDOA) of CDMA cellular network pilot signals to make twice weighted least squares (WLS), and then taking use of the original information of inertial navigation system (INS) to make fuzzy elimination, finally achieving 3D real-time positioning of the low-altitude aircraft. Monte Carlo simulation shows that the algorithm is of high speed and high precision, in the Gaussian white noise conditions, the mean square error approaches Cramer-Rao (CRLB).

articleTitle: Study for AILA Based on Artificial Psychology in Virtual Instruction
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Virtual Instruction has triggered profound changes in the field of distance education. However, ldquoteachersrdquo usually ignore the emotional factors of students in VI environment, which will severely harm the quality of learning. Affective Intervention Learning Algorithm (AILA), a novel method for emotional interaction learning in virtual instruction is proposed in the paper, which tracks the affective states of students and implements encouragement strategies appropriately through their learning journey in virtual instruction environment. Finally, an affective intervention learning model based on expression recognition is established to verify its effectiveness. The simulation results demonstrate that AILA is a feasible and effective approach to solving the problem of emotional absence in virtual instruction.

articleTitle: Source Number Estimation for Array Processing with Newton-like Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: A novel approach to the problem of detecting a passive sensor array is proposed in this paper, which is based on the optimization of a cost function with Newton-like method. The method optimizes the DOA and power parameters of a cost function simultaneously. The algorithm can estimate DOA, power and number of sources simultaneously. Computer simulation results show that the algorithm has lower region value of signal noise ratio than many methods, such as, Akaike information critical (AIC) and Gerschgorin disks estimation (GDE).

articleTitle: Extension Theory and the Application in Optimization of Immune Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: In the Immune Neural Network (INN), the key point is stability and convergence. The existing INN has shortages in the control of local optimization, so the paper bring forward INN algorithm which is based on extension theory. With the concepts of dependent function and matter-element, the improved algorithm firstly can optimize architecture and rule extraction of INN. And then, the new algorithm is applied in emulation experiment, which is used for computing of function. According to simulation results, the improved algorithm is compared with the existing INN. It indicates that extension theory has better advantage in optimization of INN. So the new algorithm has great reference value.

articleTitle: Study on Teaching Reform of Professional Core Curriculums in Teaching Elements
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: To meet the requirements of society development, improve teaching effect and train creative persons with qualification, it is necessary to realize teaching reform. With focus on realizing teaching reform in professional core curriculums, the paper describes major teaching elements and their relationship in the process of teaching and learning. Based on this, the preparation and synthetic application of various teaching methods and ways in various teaching elements are further studied.

articleTitle: Virtual Image Generation from Low Altitude Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Digital Aerial Camera
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: A new aerial digital camera with wide-angle for low altitude unmanned aerial vehicle was developed in Chinese Academy of Surveying and Mapping. This new camera can achieve high ground coverage and enlarge base-height ratio with a photographic system combined by four individual digital cameras. A complete overview is given for the composite camera system structure and the needed procedure for image post-processing is proposed. Another focus is drawn to the functional approach of setting up virtual image.

articleTitle: Attribute Reduction Based on Rough Neighborhood Approximation
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: One of the main obstacles facing current data mining techniques is attribute reduction. This paper discusses the basic concepts of rough set, and studies two rough approximations operators under neighborhood systems. An attribute reduction method based on rough set theory and neighborhood systems is presented. The experimental results show that the method of attributes reduction with rough sets and neighborhood system is feasible and valid.

articleTitle: On Training Strategy of Educational Technology Ability of Vocational and Technical Teachers
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: At present, all the countries in the world regard bringing up teachers' professional level as the breakthrough of improving education quality. Educational technology ability is an important part of teachers' professional quality. This paper expatiates the connotation and components of educational technology ability, analyzes teaching reform ideas in training educational technology ability of normal students, and explores the training strategies of educational technology ability for normal students and in-service teachers respectively according to their characteristics.

articleTitle: A Tentative Study of Teaching Method in Computer Education for the Aged Learner
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: The influence of the factors including memory descent, in coordinate movement, no adaptability of knowledge background, etc. on the computer learning of the old people was discussed. Aiming at these factors, the meditation exercise,associative memory, etc. were selected to improve the learning efficiency of learner, the methods of poetry combined with picture, pithy formula, etc. were used to reduce the baldness of learning content to improve the learnerpsilas interest in study, and the importance of strengthening confidence for the old people to learn the computer was emphasized as well.

articleTitle: A Novel Hidden Transmission of Biometric Images Based on Chaos and Image Content
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: This paper presents a novel hidden transmission method of biometric images base on chaos and image content to improve the security and secrecy of biometric verification. In our scheme, chaos is used to encrypt the watermark. The secret keys which called biokey are generated from the biometric image and used as the parameter value and initial condition of the chaotic map. The digital watermark embedded in the region of interest (ROI) of palmprint is used to recognize the palmprint has been destroyed or not and regarded as a user information index for verification. The watermarked ROI is hidden in the general public image using content-based steganography technology and transmitted secretly in case of attracting the attackerspsila attention. Our method can overcome the disadvantage of block-based steganographic techniques. Experimental results show that the security and performance of the proposed scheme are high.

articleTitle: Application Study of the Tracking of e-Learning Behavior Using the Net-Based Intelligent Robot
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: The application of the intelligent robot technology is more and more widespread and thorough in the network education. This paper briefly introduces the applications of the intelligent robot in e-learning, and discuses the application patterns of the intelligent robot, especially the net-based visual robot technology and its application in the individual intelligent information retrieval. A tracing model of web-based learner’s learning behavior based on the affective computing technology is presented. The model gives the way to trace and catch the learner’s behavior data, provides personalized learning resources and services according to learner’s learning style which is decided on the basis of the behavior data.

articleTitle: An Improved CAC Arithmetic in CDMA Systems
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: The existing papers have proposed the Call Admission Control (CAC) arithmetic based on resource reservation, which only considered ideal environment, for CDMA cellular systems with no-uniform traffic distribution among cells. This paper extends the arithmetic to intra-cell unbalanced traffic environment to make the arithmetic more practical. The inter-cell interference factor is not a constant and the proportion of reserved resource can be adaptively adjusted according to the call blocking state. Then this paper also presents an improved power control arithmetic which uses power compensation considered channel and traffic factors. Simulation results show that the improved arithmetic are both better.

articleTitle: Realtime Ray Tracing on a Hibrid Parallel Architecture
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Octrees are attractive data structures for rendering of volumes, as they provide simultaneously uniform and hierarchical data encapsulation. We present a simple and efficient algorithm for interactive ray tracing on a hybrid architectures, which takes advantage of the parallelism present by heavily exploiting the hardware for the CPU and GPU, which has been observed to give superior performance in ray tracing compared to other acceleration structures. Instead of alternating between phases of rendering and (potentially infrequent) building, our approach exploits the parallelism inherent in a multi-core system by continuously and asynchronously rebuilding new octree (potentially over the course of multiple frames) while the threads in the GPU concurrently update and traverse the most recently built octree.

articleTitle: Research on Building and Managing IT System In China
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: With the information from the survey of IT system made by applied statistics Research Centers of Renmin University of China, this research places much emphasis on analyzing the status and problems of building and managing IT system by such statistics models as cluster and correspondence analysis, and gives some advices on how to manage and build IT system.

articleTitle: Decision Support System (DSS)-Form, Development and Future
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: The decision support system (DSS) applies various data and models to human-machine interface (HMI) to assist decision-makers at each level in achieving scientific decisions. The DSS was originated in 1970s, but has seen a rapid growth. The form, development and its future growing mode will be introduced briefly in this paper.

articleTitle: A Kind of New Optimization Lagrange Neural Network Principle and Implementation
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: In the paper, a kind of Lagrange principle of optimizing neural network and realization of simple circuit is sketched, it has overcome the traditional defect based on that the neural network which punish function thought exists, deal with inequality restraint directly, reduce network size and complexity, a kind of new optimization neural network, verify his feasibility through computer numerical value emulation.

articleTitle: B2B Electronic Payment Protocol Based on iKP
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: With the increasing development of the Internet and electronic commerce, electronic payment systems have gradually become an important issue nowadays. Business-to-business e-commerce model involves a complex process with large transaction size, so that B2B payment is the next focus of the popular research topics on electronic commerce. Though there are many existing e-payment protocols designed for transactions of low-to-medium volumes and medium-to-high value, these schemes only suit for B2C and C2C E-commerce model. iKP is one of the most popular macro payment schemes using in B2C model. Considering that B2B payment is evolution of B2C payment, through analyzing the similarity and difference between B2B and B2C payment, as well as pointing out the virtues and drawbacks of iKP, this paper describes an improved iKP protocol based on B2B. The proposed protocol not only preserves the security properties of iKP but also achieves the needs of B2B payment. The future work will concentrate on satisfying different payment conditions of B2B e-payment.

articleTitle: A New Method of Constant-Current Soft Starting of Induction Motor Based on Fuzzy Control
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: This article mainly introduces the fuzzy control of induction motor during starting process. Two-input-outlet control model was used to design a specific fuzzy controller. Both minimum hardware circuit of realizing fuzzy control centered on TA89C51 and block diagram of software program are given. In addition, experimental result is shown.

articleTitle: The Improved Method of FGS and Simulation Based on DCT and Wavelet Transform
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: With the increase of streaming video application on the Internet, the requirement of video compression has changed. The improved method of fine granular scalability(FGS) is given, which based on the wavelet transform and discrete cosine transform(DCT). The simulation has verified, which proves the feasibility of the method.

articleTitle: Discussing and Researching on Engineering Courses Teaching in the University
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: A majority of engineering courses in the university have these characteristics such as much period, extensive content, very strong practice etc. The paper takes auto detecting and maintenance specialty as an example to analyze problems of engineering courses in the university in the practice teaching, and put forward many methods, means and new teaching mode to resolve these problems to improve further classroom teaching effect. The virtual instrument technology and the network technology are applied in teaching practice, which resolves the contradiction between more students and short teaching resource.

articleTitle: Numerical Calculation of the Vibrancies of the Floating Assembled-Pipeline on the Sea Based on FEM
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: In this paper, the vibrancies of floating assembled-pipeline on the sea was analyzed by the inherent vibrancies character analysis method and the FEM model was erected to simulate the landscape orientation bending vibration of the pipelines by ADINA software, the conclusion was obtained that the landscape orientation bending vibration of pipelines was able to meet with the requirements of pipelinespsila function under the 4 class sea-condition.

articleTitle: Research & Development of e-Learning System for Problem-Based Education
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: CHCGeS is a Computer Hardware Course Groups e-Learning System. It can support and complement the problem-based education model with knowledge transferring. The system utilizes internet teaching methods, co-establishing and shared educational resource database, and the knowledge-point link. With the system, the idea of teacher-guided and student-based systematic knowledge studying, interactive learning and problem-based learning, can meet the requirement of modern computer education.

articleTitle: Image Abnormal Region Recognition with Fuzzy Clustering Based on Multi-Characteristic Variable Window
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: This paper proposes a new pattern recognition algorithm with fuzzy clustering based on multi-characteristic variable window. This algorithm can recognize the abnormal region for dynamic image. The image is divided into some windows by this algorithm, and multi-characteristic vector of each window is constructed. The weight factor vector is introduced so that each window characteristic may be primary or secondary according to different image feature. The window coefficient is introduced so that the recognition speed and precision can be adjusted. In this paper, the objective function, membership function and clustering center calculation function of fuzzy clustering algorithm with weight factor and window coefficient is proposed. At last, this paper takes example for fabric defects recognition with this algorithm. Experimental results show that this algorithm can recognize more categories of image abnormal regions with high-accuracy, high-speed, no-training and extensive application.

articleTitle: Applications of Computer Technology on Modern Chemistry Teaching and Research
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Computer technology has been applied in teaching and research of every subject. In this paper, the actions of multimedia technology in university chemistry teaching are analyzed, the necessity and feasibility of computer simulation are discussed, and the applications of computer data technology are introduced.

articleTitle: Research on the Design of Network Courses Based on Constructivism
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: A network course is a new organizational form of teaching content, while constructivism is the core theory in the field of contemporary educational technology. According to constructivism theory, knowledge is not mainly acquired by learning from teachers, but by means of meaning construction. Scene, collaboration, conversation and meaning construction are the four elements of the learning environment. Based on the comprehension of network course concept and constructivism learning theory, the author presents some design principles of network courses, which includes Principle of guidance and initiative, Principle of real scene and Principle of collaborative learning, and then introduces the overall structural design of a network course: Survey on E-commerce.

articleTitle: Analysis and Application for Virtual Learning Community
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: With the rapid development of informational technology, virtual community has played an important role in the progress of informational education. But on whatpsilas virtual learning community, there are many viewpoints. Someone thinks itpsilas a learning environment; someone regards it as a learning tool and so on. Based on the research existed, this article restudies the virtual learning community from the visual angle of sociology, technology, educational psychology, social culture and gives an example lastly so that we can deeply understand it.

articleTitle: Is Current Active Queue Management Really Necessary
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: In this letter, we question the superiority of current RED, PI and REM active queue management algorithms by proposing an improved droptail gateway. This improved drop tail adopts random packet drop to avoid global synchronization and deadlock of traffic flows; it also try to keep the instantaneous queue size around the predefined value. The simulation results manifest that this improved drop tail meets the most performance of AQMs, which would make them not so necessary in the real network routers.

articleTitle: SMID: A Semantic Model of Instructional Design
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: This paper proposes a general method to build a semantic model of instructional design. At the meantime, a semantic model is also proposed (called SMID), which mainly includes ontology and processing module. SMID ontology includes several ontologies for instructional design, such as knowledge object ontology, material object ontology, learning goal ontology,instructional strategy ontology, learning action ontology; SMID processing module means the processing method used in instructional design, including knowledge selection, instructional strategy selection, learning action sequence generation, learning resource sequence generation. With J2EE Platform and Drool tools, the SMID system is implemented. At last, experiments with basic arithmetic operations are demonstrated and conclusions are also drawn.

articleTitle: On the “Engineering Analysis” Teaching and the Engineering Competency Cultivation of Application-Oriented Talents
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: This paper, based on comprehensive analysis to the education way of Fachhochschule (German universities of application science and technology) and Chinese actual conditions, discusses how the education way of Fachhochschule enlightens the cultivation of the application-oriented talents of Civil Engineering in China, and sets forth the detailed ideas and ways for implementing ldquoEngineering Analysisrdquo teaching based on computer simulation technology so as to enhance the cultivation of engineering competency of application-oriented talents.

articleTitle: A Grid-based E-Assessment IRT-Item Bank Platform
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: E-learning has been an important way, method, target and criterion of modern teaching. E-assessment is an important component of e-learning and e-qualification. Item Banks using Item Response Theory are the basis of e-assessment. With the application of WEB technology, how to share item bank resources becomes one of the problems to be solved imperatively in e-assessment. This paper proposes a grid-based e-assessment platform by use of resource-fused tree grid to meet the evolving needs of e-assessment, which include technology, content, and services. This platform tries to solve the problem of shared item resources in e-assessment, which is a topic-oriented, intelligent, scalable, distributed, efficient and reliable platform. It is practically to achieve resource knowledge management, uniform and transparent share access, and collaborative security control.

articleTitle: The Design of Trusted Access Scheme Based on Identity for WiMAX Network
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: To enhance access security capability of WiMAX (Worldwide Interoperability for Microwave Access), a trusted access scheme based on identity is proposed in this paper. It adopts trusted access architecture which includes three layers: identity layer, evaluation layer and authentication layer. Firstly, every entity is assigned only an identity in the identity layer; secondly, credible attribute of the entity is evaluated in the evaluation layer; lastly, authentication layer judges the evaluation results that evaluation layer refers. The scheme uses biology authentication and mutual authentication, then controls access of the user or terminal and chooses the service strategy of service side. Security analysis indicates that the scheme can prevent unlicensed user access, unlicensed terminal access, unlicensed base station attack and message modification.

articleTitle: A Genetic Algorithm Based Method of Fault Maintenance in Software-Intensive System
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: This paper analyzes the problem of fault maintenance in software-Intensive system. The problem is described and modeled by a genetic algorithm (GA) based method. After a complete investigation on elements involved in the problem, the controls parameters in GA are confirmed. The feasibility and the degree of accuracy of the GA based method are tested by an example in the end.

articleTitle: An Empirical Research on Scenario Training Method of Intercultural Communication Capacity and Its Performance Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: In response to the demand for educational reform, this paper aims at cultivating college studentspsila intercultural communication competence on the basis of intercultural communication theory and empirical research method. Scenario training method, assisted with specific cases, was constructed, and hypothesis test tool was applied to analyzing its effect as well. The conclusion shows that this scenario training method is positive to improve studentspsila intercultural communication competence.

articleTitle: Design of Automatic Wire Drawing Machine Control System Based on ARM and FPGA
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: The wire drawing machine is a kind of highly automated metallica machine controlled by microcontroller, and it's used mainly in fabrication of wire in metal industry. Based on the analysis of the structure and theory of wire drawing machine, a doable design is discussed. A 32-bit ARM microprocessor and FPGA were used to be master controller and sub-controller respectively, and the automatic control of the embedded wire drawing machine was realized. It is worthwhile to be popularized for the control system with many advantages, such as high reliability and precision, low cost, and strong capability to be transplanted.

articleTitle: A Study on Pedagogics of Econometrics for Undergraduate
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: In order to help the students to master the theoretical knowledge and enhance their ability to work out practical solutions for economic issues, the pedagogics of econometrics should integrate lectures, experiments and case study. This paper is concerned with the content should be included in lectures and experiments, and the difficulties should be noticed in case study.

articleTitle: A Critical Review of Educational Technology in English Language Teaching in China
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Educational technology has been widely applied in the English Language Teaching (ELT) in China for a long period of time. Especially since the 1990s with the development of information technology, it has become an indispensable part of ELT in Chinese colleges and universities. This paper attempts to discuss the use of educational technology in ELT through a critical survey of its advantages and potential dangers in both classroom teaching and after-class learning. It argues that, as most widely used in ELT, educational technology can extend and complement the traditional teaching and learning activities, such as motivating students, inspiring teachers, and maximizing the utilization of teaching resources; yet teachers must have a critical consciousness of the dehumanizing effect of technology in ELT, which needs to be counteracted in the humanist sphere of the study of English language and its culture. The alternative to the dilemma of technology vs. humanity lies in the construction of human subjective agency in ELT, which ensures creative interaction in the teaching and learning process.

articleTitle: BP Neural Network-Based Research of University Science Research Capability Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Based on the substance of university science research capability (USRC) and the highly self-organized, self-adapted and self-learned characteristics of back propagation (BP) neural network, the paper conducts a research on evaluation of USRC, in which an evaluation index system of USRC is constructed and a 15-7-1-typed BP neural network with three layers is presented to evaluate USRC, which provides a BP neural network-based methodology for evaluation of USRC with multiple inputs.

articleTitle: Medical Image Compression Based on Ordered Binary Decision Diagrams
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: A new approach for lossless compression of medical images has been proposed. After preprocessing, the image is split into bit planes to which the compressed technique is applied. These bit planes can be expressed as ordered binary decision diagrams (OBDD) and coding. This approach compared well with WINZIP in terms of compression ratio.

articleTitle: A Brief Analysis of the Design of Customer Relationship Management System in Sports Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: This study aims at explaining how to make full use of information technology and computer technology to establish close associations between the sports enterprises and their customers in this modernized society. This paper presents a possible solution for the sports enterprise to augment the social interactions, improve customerspsila satisfaction and loyalty, promote a good image, increase their visibility, and enhance the brand popularities with cohesiveness strengthened so as to improve the social and economic benefits.

articleTitle: A General Formula for One-Dimensional Collisions
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: This article presents a new deriving method of a simple formula for all kinds of one-dimensional collision. The formula and the method are easy to be learned and remembered for students than traditional equations for one-dimensional collision. The article presents five different ways to deal with the same question, and suggests that teaching students different ways to deal with the same question is better than one. So it is useful for both of teachers teaching and students learning.

Author Keywords: velocity of the center of mass

articleTitle: A Classifier Selection Strategy for Lazy Bayesian Rules Based on Local Accuracy Estimation
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Lazy Bayesian rule (LBR) is a novel classification method of high predictability. However, its classifier selection strategy is somewhat simple, in that it always uses the most specific one to make the final decision. In this paper, we suggest to use the one with the highest estimated local accuracy at the target instance point instead. To materialize this idea, this paper proposes an efficient mechanism for estimating the local accuracy of a local classifier. This mechanism can be easily integrated into the LBR algorithm, and therefore leads to a classifier selection strategy for LBR. Experimental results have shown that this classifier selection strategy can reduce the error rate of the original LBR algorithm averagely over a variety of domains.

articleTitle: A Modified Anonymous Proxy Signature with a Trusted Party
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: In 2002, Shum and Wei proposed a anonymous proxy signature, that is, no one can determine the identity of the proxy signer only from the proxy signature, and a trusted party can reveal the proxy signerpsilas identity if needed. However, in 2005, Narn-Yih Lee *, Ming-Feng Lee showed that the Shum-Wei scheme cannot keep the property of the strong unforgeability, and the original signer can generate valid proxy signatures. On the base of that, so we present a modified anonymous proxy signature with a trusted party, which adds the proxy signer private key in the proxy signature key, and the aim is to avoid the original signerpsilas forging proxy signature. Finally, we give the simple security analysis and conclude our scheme is unforgeable and secure.

articleTitle: A Virtualized Harvard Architectural Approach to Protect Kernel Code
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Most modern computers which implement the von Neumann architecture have the risk of being attacked by modifying kernel code, because code is put in the same address space as the data. In this paper, the virtualization of Harvard memory architecture is implemented as a patch to the current operating system to separate the code fetch and the data operation on the kernel code, and thus solve the problem at its root. The implementation of our virtualization is described in detail, its effectiveness to resist attacks is evaluated and the impact on the current operating system is fully analyzed. The experiment results show our approach is effective, has no side effect on the normal functions of the operating system and incurs very little overhead.

articleTitle: Wu's Elimination Method in Graphing Calculator
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Wu's method is one of the most popular approach to solve multivariate nonlinear equations proposed by Wu Wentsun. Wu's elimination method is the main idea of Wu's method. It is widely used in mechanical proving, automated reasoning, scientific computing, computer graphics, etc. The graphics calculator is commonly used in education and advanced mathematics research. Before Wu's elimination method has been implemented on personal computers, however it's not adaptive for movable learning. Hence we propose a scheme and algorithm on graphing calculator according to characteristics of embedded system and implement the algorithm in Noah graphing calculator. Our program can also be used in other graphing calculator based on GIAC. It is very helpful for better understanding of elimination in multivariate nonlinear equations for mathematics education.

articleTitle: Application of Microteaching under Network Environment
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: This paper made suggestions as to the modifying and improving of the traditional microteaching under network environment. This paper discussed the shortcomings of microteaching, explained that it is necessary to apply the microteaching under the network environment after describing its function and advantage, and concludes with the implementing measures.

articleTitle: Research on Fitness Exercises' Promotion with Multi-Agent Simulation
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: On the impact of chinapsilas economic development, people are more interesting in Fitness Exercises Fitness exercises have already become a growing movement for a personpsilas the demand during leisure time. Fitness exercises are just like products for people, because they also can satisfy peoplepsilas demand. People do fitness exercises just like consuming the product. So it is useful to use product diffusion theory to study fitness exercises. Computer simulation models are more and more imported into social science, and by now, multi-agent simulation is very common in social science research. It is a simulation way on micro level to study the whole. In this paper, it is discussed the clubspsila fitness exercisespsila promotion, and it is analyzed their diffusion based on a multi-agent simulation model. By repeat experiments, it is discussed three major factors, that is advertising, word of mouth and duration, in fitness diffusion process, and it is also advised the clubspsila strategies.

articleTitle: Research on Trusted Federated Identity Management and Its Application
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: It is hard to judge whether one subject is to be trusted where federation identity management only focuses on identity trust achieved by credentials the subject hold. So we propose a behavior trust-based federation identity management mechanism. The trust value was modified according to the subjectpsilas behavior and it will be employed in identity management procedure including identity mapping and identity provision. Then policy-based trust value monitor will adjust the subjectpsilas inter-domain access permissions so as to encourage the subject to act properly.

articleTitle: Information Technology and Professional Development of Secondary School English Teachers - A Case Study in Shandong Province
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Taking professional development of secondary school English teachers (SSETs) as focus, a case study is made in Shandong province. According to the analysis of the research, the non-optimistic state and imbalance of professional development to SSETs in different districts are revealed, and the common problems - time-limitation, non-systematic continuing professional development (CPD) and non-guidance in professional development - are discussed. To change the situation and solve the problems, a feasible three-stage model of SSETs' professional development is established on the basis of the application of practical and effective information technology forms as blog, online chat, e-mail, hoping to provide some enlightenment to the education of SSETspsila professional development.

articleTitle: Development of Knowledge Management Learning System for Supporting Computer Courses in Junior High School
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: This paper presents the knowledge management learning system (KMLS) that allows students to capture, store, share, apply and create knowledge based on the learning requirements of junior high school students' computer courses. By using the system in an actual teaching environment and comparing the results with traditional lectures, we explore its impact on learning achievement at junior high school computer courses in Taiwan; once a questionnaire survey was carried out among the students to collect valuable suggestions and find out their level of acceptance for the computer course's KMLS.

articleTitle: Reform Path Selection of the University Logistic System Socialization Based on the Modularization Theory
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: By applying the modularization theory and on the basis of the systematical analysis about the landmark model and its constituent elements at different stages of the University logistic system socialization reform, this paper puts forward the modularization system of Universities logistics socialization reform, establishes the strategic analysis and implementation framework of the logistics socialization reformation based on the resources and the logistical capacity, constructs the universities logistic socialization reform path selection model based on modularization theory in different systems, and provides a decision-making method to motivate the logistics socialization reform to the universities administrators.

articleTitle: A Spiral-Decoding Method for Web Data Extraction
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: In this paper, we discuss the problem that how to realize the context-ware wrapping. We consider the peer sources to facilitate the matching task and enhance a wrapperpsilas extraction accuracy by leverage the peer wrappers or domain rule. First, we bring in the concept context-ware wrapping. With the problem how to realize it, then we propose a spiral-decoding method to synchronize the extractions by spiral decoding. At last, we give the algorithm to realize it.

articleTitle: Study on Structural Features of University Teacher Need and Teacher Professional Development
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Human resources of colleges and universities were the most important resource in higher education resources and important assurance of higher education development, and teachers of colleges and universities were the main force of college and university human resources. In this paper, computer data analysis on need hierarchical structure of part Heilongjiang colleges and universities and difference of different-type teacher need, effect of internal and external motivational factors on different-type teachers and the main factors that affected enthusiasm and satisfaction degree had been studied with SPSS method, reference method and questionnaire method. Scientific and practicable motivational strategy had been obtained by the analysis and study, which would have advisable and instructive function for strengthening teacher team construction and promoting teacher professional development.

articleTitle: Research and Development of Interactive Remote Control Teaching System of Central Air-Conditioning
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: The paper introduces the remote control teaching system of central air-conditioning. It designs idea to carry through interactive distant education in remote control teaching system. It expatiates the methods, process and thoughts to accomplish distant education by applying modern education technology and interactive teaching methods. By means of these , the distant teaching and training of central air-conditioning system could be realized and shared.

articleTitle: Web Structure Optimization Appraisal Plan Based on Visiting Thing
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: The optimization and appraisal of Web structure is a significant hard problem. In this paper, using the association rule to discover the effective link, using the false association rule to discover invalid link, and the definition of the false association rule is given n. An evaluation function of the Web site optimization is proposed by combination between maximal forward reference path and reference length, which makes the transaction more accurate to optimize the Web structure, and the related experiment is given, the experimental result verifies the credibility of the appraisal plan, the result of the study is a good reference for related research.

articleTitle: Web-Based Training Framework for China School Teachers Educational Technique Ability Training
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: From virtual learning environment point of view, to establish a supporting system for national teacher education technology training will benefit and solve a series of key issues that the training faced with, meanwhile, it will provide possibility for training assessment. this paper, starting from analyzing key characteristic of our teacher technology ability training supporting network, has described the three layer distributed architecture of web-based training framework(WTF). And then we introduced key elements of how WTF works to support teachers' education technology ability development. In the end of this paper, it summarized its running status in past three years in the national teacher training program.

articleTitle: Application-Level Traffic Identification of Network Security Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Along with the development of the Internet and strengthening of network protocol, it becomes more and more difficult to monitor network. And some sensitive information has been leaked outside the application environment. A major problem with current security monitoring is the large number of newly emerging applications using more complicated communication structures and patterns than traditional applications. The ability to accurately identify the Internet traffic associated with different application-level protocols is essential to a security monitoring system. Traditional traffic identification method based on well-known port numbers is becoming more inaccurate and not appropriate for the identification of P2P and other new types of traffics. This paper proposes a new method to identify application level traffic.First, we categorized most application level protocols according to their characters. With this classification, we use signatures matching to determine the name of the traffic. Finally, a test has been carried out to evaluate the accuracy and efficiency of this method.

articleTitle: Design and Implement Computer Networking Virtual Laboratory
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Experimental teaching is of great importance in computer networking. In this paper, we analyze the problems encountered in real-world laboratory, and propose a Web based computer networking virtual laboratory to facilitate learning and teaching in the education of computer networking. The design and implementation of such a system are analyzed in detail. Our experiences of using it in computer network teaching show that this laboratory enables students to share resources of physical and virtual equipments and understand the knowledge more clearly. Finally, the paper concludes with feedbacks in teaching and discusses future developments.

articleTitle: Personalized Search Based on Hybrid Clustering Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Search engines have become the main tools of information retrieval, but failing to reflect the userpsilas true interest. Research on personalized information retrieval has become an important topic. Clustering technique is very important to improve search results.This paper proposed A novel personalized search method which is based on density and hierarchical, and this method fully considered the user interest. On the basis of lucene and Nutch, Experiments show that it can improve clustering results and search precision for users.

articleTitle: Experimental Tool for the Teaching of Logistics Based on the Virtual Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: In many schools, the current teaching methods for students majoring in logistics can't bridge the gap between logistical theories and real worlds. The teaching methods and tools are not sufficient to the need of the society. Except for optimizing the structure of teaching faculties and restructuring the teaching schedule, the universities should reinforce the building of logistics experimental platform to combine the theory and real world. Based on Virtual Enterprise (enterprise practice) model with JAVA, this paper proposes a virtual supply chain platform for the experiments of students. In the virtual supply chain, many experiments can be conducted. These experiments consist of the cooperation and competition between firms. The experiment platform is beneficial to the studying and teaching efficiencies for the major of logistics.

articleTitle: Local Routing and Traffic Estimating in Large Scale-Free Networks
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: In this paper, we first propose a traffic model to investigate the connections between local routing strategies and traffic flow on scale-free networks. Then, we put forward ldquotopological information functionrdquo with a control parameter to represent a cluster of local routing strategies. By defining the effective betweenness of nodes, we introduce the formula of the maximal communication capability of a network and find that traditional optimal algorithm doesn't work well when the scale of the network becomes very large. A new solution is presented and proved by us to be better than traditional one. In order to further increase the packets delivering capacity of a scale-free network, we put forward a new class of local routing algorithms based on the effective betweenness of nodes. Experimental results show that these routing algorithms work very well in large scale-free networks.

articleTitle: The Relationship between Undergraduates' English Performances in School and Motivations to Participate in English Learning Outside of School in China: An Empirical Study
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: As the world is becoming more global, English as a common language of the world is becoming more and more important in various fields. Nearly all the universities have opened English courses in China; however, there are many students, whether have very poor or very good English performance in school, willing to spend money in participating in English training outside of school. This paper is designed to explore the relationship between undergraduates' English performances in school and motivations to participate in English learning outside of school in China by empirical methods. The results show: the motivations contain development, interest, showing, to go abroad, situations, to obtain employment, and to escape from reality; among which students at different levels of performance have different motivations on interest, to escape from reality, and situations.

articleTitle: Validity Evaluation of Team Learning Based on DEA
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Learning team construction has already become strategic choice between objective needs and the survival of the enterprise. The enterprise pays much attention to the validity of team learning. This article constructs the performance of multi-level evaluation index system and validity evaluation of team learning mathematical model based on DEA. Combined with the case, the model is used to evaluate the performance of a complex system, which is composed of more than one homogeneous decision-making unit and have more influencing factors (multi-input) and output index (multi-output). To compare the order of team learning performance, determine the validity of technology and scale, analyses team learning problem diagnoses, and so on. By contrast with other analyses, comparing the validity evaluation of team learning of different teams simultaneously and contrasting the asynchronous validity evaluation of team learning about the same team to evaluate the validity of team learning according to DEA method. It is significant for improving team learning performance management level and resource utilization rate.

articleTitle: Research and Application on Three Dimensional Computational Fluid Dynamics Software Based on KIVA-3V Code
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: To calculate turbulent movement and combustion in internal combustion (IC) engines the three dimensional software (KIVA-3V code) is analyzed. Computational fluid dynamics (CFD) has become an established tool for the design and understanding of practical combustion systems. Multidimensional models have proven their value in reducing the need for physical experimentation, the benefit of which has been a reduction in product development time and cost. All features and capabilities of the original KIVA-3 have been retained. The grid generator, K3PREP, has been expanded to support the generation of grids with valves, along with the shaping of valve ports and runners. Graphics output options have also been expanded and the new features are discussed. Since in a real diesel engine the wall temperature are not constant, but varied over the cycle, energy equation in standard KIVA-code is modified because of effect of wall heat. Since the shape of piston (4JB1) is not on the axis of symmetry, 3600 ¬ was modeled which corresponds x-offset 4mm and y-offset 1 mm. Finally, schematic of the test bench configuration and engine specification are showed, cylinder pressures and the corresponding heat release rates with variation of injection timing are compared with experimental data. It gives the new theory and method about calculating turbulent movement and combustion exactly in IC engine.

articleTitle: A New Neural Network Approach to Electronic Circuit Fault Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: To overcome the deficiencies of single neural network such as low diagnosis precision, long training time and bad generalized ability, an integrated neural network classifier is proposed for electronic circuit fault diagnosis in the paper. The investigation shows that the proposed method has higher classification precision and reliability, and is an ideal pattern classifier. Both simulation and experiment indicate that the proposed method is quite effective and ubiquitous.

articleTitle: Short-Term Load Forecasting Model Based on LS-SVM in Bayesian Inference
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Short-term load forecasting is very important for power system. A combined excellent model based on least squares support vector machines in bayesian inference is proposed in this paper to do the short-term load forecasting. Least squares support vector machines (LS-SVM) are new kinds of support vector machines (SVM) which regress faster than the standard SVM, they are adopt to do the forecasting, and the parameters of model proposed are gained in the three levels of bayesian inference. A real case is experimented with to test the performance of the model, the result shows that the proposed combined model outperforms BP network which is choose to be the comparative model, so improving  the accuracy of load forecasting.

articleTitle: The Innovation of the Operating Model of E-commerce and Travel Agency
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Because of the digitization of operational management, the application of e-commerce in the travel agency industry is broader compared with most of other industries and has a more profound impact on the operating model of the travel agencies. Drawing on a long-term research and tracking study of the domestic large and medium-sized travel agencies, the paper sums up the e-commerce's operating model of travel agencies, as well as the corresponding innovation of operating model and management systems, and unfolds on several issues of travel agencies' operation under the background of e-commerce.

articleTitle: Behavioral Science-Based Information Security Research
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Inspects the domestic and foreign each kind of information security event to discover that behind information security event representation, those who play the decision role is the human, the human is in the information security the most active factor, human's behavior and the information security is closely related, human's unsafe behavior causes accident's primary cause. The paper has studied the demand, the motive and the behavior relations, has studied the user network behavioral model, and based on this model analysis user legitimate and tort, has obtained the information security behavior management model through the behavior research, proposed against human wall and the manpower firewall's idea, the paper conclusion is humanist is broad based on the behavioral science information security research prospect, can develop one's ability to the full.

articleTitle: Wireless Application of Chemical Formula Naming in Query Optimization
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Nowadays, Getting on line via cell phones is becoming an essential Internet information retrieval tool in digital information space which makes the new era of Mobile Internet rapidly develops. On the basis of chemical formula naming specification, the custom-built user profile and the automatic user profile are combined to a new technology approach, which is called optimized Intelligent Query Algorithm. The algorithm makes use of the structure to effectively retrieve information, and is applied to the design of query system based on J2ME. Simulation tests prove that this algorithm can improve retrieve effectively, and have excellent adaptability.

articleTitle: The Application of Competency Based on Unascertained Measure
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: With the changing of environment both inside and outside, the HR are increasingly becoming the source to construction the competitive advantage and access the sustainable development. The proposed of competency theory provides a new perspective to construction the HR management system based on competency. Introducing briefly the theory of competency, a competency model based on unascertained measure is developed. It has the significance both in theoretical and in practical.

articleTitle: Applying Computer to Connectively Analyze the Dynamic Factors in Physical Training
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: In this paper, a method is presented for connectively analyzing the dynamic factors in physical training by utilizing computers. Through analyzing the training results of a certain triple jumper, the thesis expounds how to build the mathematics models for the connective factors in system and it also presents the detailed procedure by utilizing these models to connectively analyze the dynamic changes of the factors in system. It will supply a scientific method for the staff who is engaged in physical teaching and training by utilizing computers to do the researching and managing work in physical training.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Method of Block-Based Region Growing and Visible Color Difference for Color Image Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: In this paper we propose a color image segmentation algorithm based on visible color difference and block-based region growing techniques. Firstly, the original image is divide into image blocks which are not overlapped; then, the mean and variance of each image black was calculated in CIEL*a*b* color space, and the image blocks were divided into homogeneous color blocks and texture blocks by the variance of it. The Initial seed regions are automatically selected depending on calculating the homogeneous color blockspsila color difference in CIEL*a*b* color space and spatial and adjacent information. The quadtree decomposition algorithm was applied to split and merge the texture blocks. Finally, the region growing and merging algorithm was to use and achieve the segmentation result. The experimental segmentation results hold favorable consistency in terms of human perception, and confirm effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Experimental Research about the Impact of IEEE 802.1P on Real-time Behavior of Switched Industrial Ethernet
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Based on the test-bed which had been built, a series of practical experiments have been carried out to study the impact of IEEE 802.1P on Real-time behavior of switched industrial Ethernet. Comparing the experimental results with the theoretical analysis, the differences between experiment and theory analysis were found. The experiments expose many problems when IEEE 802.1P is applied to the Switched Industrial Ethernet such as the interference between the different priority levels message and the misbehavior of the switch which would happen when the port is overloaded. The experiments carried out can direct the theory and practical improvement about real-time property of industrial Ethernet for process control.

articleTitle: The Application of Iterative Metacognitive Theory in Electrical Engineering Experiment Teaching
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Graduates not only need to learn, but needed to learn how to learn efficiently and effectively, specially in experiment course. Therefore, the well-known and widely accepted concept, metacognition, is revisited for use in a power systems experiment course. For conflict between continuous studying proceed and isolated cognitive way, the iterative metacognition is put forward. The new metacognition may accelerate the studying efficiency, especially in experiment course. A combination of improved metacognition and the appropriate use of innovated experiment learning model may be one solution for addressing this issue. The study examined the current use of iterative metacognitive strategies in a innovated experiment unit at Northeastern University and how these strategies could be adopted to increase learning effectiveness. The study investigates how iterative way can support the metacognitive aspects of learning.

articleTitle: Microphone Array Speech Enhancement Based on Filter Bank Generalized Sidelobe Canceller
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: In order to accelerate the convergence of the microphone array speech enhancement system based on generalized sidelobe canceller (GSC), the input signals of the adaptive module are decomposed into their subbands by filter bank to perform the multichannel adaptive filter (MCAF) in each subband. The columns of the blocking matrix are derived from a prototype vector by cosine modulation, and these columns constitute a series of bandpass filters, which select signals with specific directions of arrival and frequencies. Further exploited by subband decomposition and suitably discarding the low-pass subbands prior to running independent unconstrained adaptive filters in each nonredundant subband, the computational complexity of a GSC implementation is greatly reduced compared to fully adaptive GSC schemes. Finally, based on the introduction of post-filtering technology, it eliminates the incoherent noise. Experiments indicate that the speech enhancement algorithm based on filter bank GSC have higher converging speed and better output signal to noise ratio (SNR) than the fullband GSC.

articleTitle: Study on Monitoring and Fault Diagnosis for Ignition System of Engines
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: The test technology for ignition system of automobile engine has been introduced, and the model of distributed monitoring and diagnosis system has been proposed in this paper. The whole structure of this monitoring and diagnosis system has been introduced. Moreover, method for pertinent knowledge acquisition, analysis and organization has been discussed. Finally, typical applications for distributor centrifugal organization model and ignition coil model by using the monitoring and fault diagnosis system are provided.

articleTitle: The Schema and Implementation of a Model Machine Based on DFA Theorem
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Based on Deterministic Finite Automaton (DFA) and combinational logic circuits, an implementation of a model machine using Verilog HDL and top-down method is proposed. This paper describes how to design each of its parts with the schema of DFA in Verilog HDL and simulates the machine in the end.

articleTitle: Query Reformulation Based on Improved Pseudo Feedback
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Now the difficulty of information query on the Web is there is not matching between short, misty user query and the document of existing a great deal of redundancy and noise. Anew query method was brought forward based on first item clicked feedback under the analyzed excellent and disadvantage of relevance feedback and pseudo feedback.Present a measure of first item-clicked feedback. The experiment adopted testing data of TREC Web Track show it can increase query efficiency in the information query, conquer the disadvantage of relevance feedback and pseudo feedback.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Network Course of Database Principle
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: The article analyzes the web page, multimedia and database technologies basing on giving a minute description of four modules of the network course of database principle: course learning, exercise and test, teaching assistant and system management. Finally, it sums up the characteristics and applications of the network courses.

articleTitle: ANN Approach for Existing Bridge Evaluation Based on Grid and Domain Knowledge
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: The development of a methodology for accurate and reliable condition assessment of existing bridges has become very important. This paper presents a method for estimating the status of RC beam bridges using an artificial neural network based on grid and domain knowledge, which can help bridge agency to determine the bridge state more systematically in comparison with the existing bridge risk assessment methodologies which require a large number of subjective judgments from bridge experts to build the complicated nonlinear relationships among the relative importance of attributes. As a conclusion, when the calculated bridge rating and evaluation time compared with the ANN method, it is proven that the proposed algorithm provided results similar to those obtained by experts, but can improve efficiency of bridge state assessment.

articleTitle: On Teaching Innovation of the Course
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: This paper researches on teaching innovation of the course management. After analyzing the dilemma in management teaching, this paper points out that teachers should make idea, method and means innovation. As for idea innovation, the flexible application of behaviorism, cognitivism and constructivism is stressed. As for method innovation, the combinations of academy with application, the mutual promotion of teaching and theoretical research, the application of other disciplinespsila knowledge, and the knowledge of management from documents describing humanpsilas activities are stressed. As for means or tools innovation, the author argues that management teachers should apply multimedia technology to improve management teaching ,and apply Internet to improve management teaching.

articleTitle: Application of Cellular Neural Network to Contour Detection in QuickBird Remotely Sensing Images Associated with Mathematical Morphology
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: For the purpose of extracting the features in high spatial resolution QuickBird panchromatic images, and of using the images into various fields, this paper presented a method to detect the contour of features in QuickBird remotely sensing images based on mathematical morphology (MM) integrated with cellular neural network (CNN). Firstly, remove the noise in images using open-closing morphological filter; secondly, utilize a CNN-based contour detection algorithm to detect the contour in the filtered images. The experimental results show that contour detection based on proposed approach is more effective than that of either morphological gradient algorithm-based or CNN contour detection algorithm based.

articleTitle: The Network Virtual Money Supply Based on Profit Maximization of the Online Game Operator
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: The online virtual money is issued by private-owned game operator, with the goal of profit maximization, which makes a significant difference in the money issuance mechanism between virtual money and real money. This paper focused on studying whether the operator, driven by profit maximization, would over-supply the virtual money and cause inflation in virtual world. Two virtual money supply models based on the short-term and long-term profit maximization of the game operator were developed in this paper, and we found that the game operator will not over-supply the virtual money. When the game operator pursues for long-term profit maximization, the optimal virtual money supply will less than that of short-term profit maximization. Motivated by the profit maximization, the game operator will expand virtual money supply with the growth of total online time in the virtual community to avoiding the inflation and maintaining the stability of the virtual economy. Market force will take effect in constraining the behavior of game operator.
