articleTitle: A Multi-level Threshold Multi-Secret Sharing Scheme with Periodic Renewing
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: In multi-secret sharing schemes, the secrets can only be shared in the same threshold. A multi-level threshold multi-secret sharing scheme with periodic renewing based on the intractability of the discrete logarithm is proposed. The scheme has the following characteristics: The secrets can be shared in the multiple level threshold .The multiple secrets can be shared in the same level threshold. The master shadow of every participant can be renewed periodically.

articleTitle: Online Tutorship Practice in Graduation Design
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Some matters on online tutorship in graduation design are discussed, which are the definition of online tutorship and learning interaction, studentspsila preference to tutorship means for graduation design, learning loneliness and the vicarious interaction in online tutorship. The advantages of online tutorship are following: the flexibility management, sharing resources of teachers, information and literature, training studentspsila initiative and exploratory spirit, and teaching benefits teachers as well as students. Online tutorship canpsilat substitute completely classroom teaching, however, two means should have complementary advantages and supplement each other.

articleTitle: Real-Time Restoration for Motion-Blurred Color Images by Multichannel Combination Processing
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: A fast algorithm is proposed to restore the color images, degraded in a deterministic way by motion- blurred,by multichannel combination processing. Based on the color space conversion model, the point spread functions of the image motion on each plane of YUV422 image can be achieved.The U, V plane of YUV422 images are combined to form a newel plane which has the same size as Y plane. Then, the Y, UV plane are packed into a two dimensional complex array which can be transformed directly by FFT and result a composite frequency spectrum. Wiener filter is applied to filter Y, UV spectrums separated from the composite spectra. On Graphics Processing Unit (GPU) platform, the proposed algorithm can restore a 1024times1024 24-bit motion-blurred color image in 7.95 ms, and the PSNR of the restored image is 27.12 which reveals a good restoration performance.

articleTitle: A QoS-Oriented Network Architecture Based on Virtualization
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Today's best-effort Internet with "one fits all" principle comes to an impasse. Addressed to different QoS requirements of today's network services, we propose a QoS oriented Network Architecture that bases on network virtualization. It provides multiple virtual networks deploying on the same substrate, each is designed with a special designing goal and is running a customized protocol. Then the traffic with different QoS requirements is classified at the ingress router, and distributed to different virtual networks the most suitable. To verify this idea, a prototype is implemented in the LAN-scale network. By simple comparison of traffic transmitted over different virtual networks which are running different designed QoS mechanisms, we observe that, by use of our network architecture, service provider with specific QoS requirements can take its choice to choose appropriate network to achieve better QoS performance.

articleTitle: To Explore Teaching Mode of Logistics System Simulation
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: This paper demonstrates the linkage between logistics system simulation and teaching mode, and explores new teaching methods and teaching ideas. It puts emphasis on analyzing the application of logistics simulation technology in the logistics system and exploring appropriate teaching modes of logistics system simulation. We make a point of the application of logistics system theory knowledge and the training of practical ability. Based on those above, it also expatiates upon cases analytical method full of inspiration and practicality, the experimental training method, and integration of teaching, learning and research methods, and so on. It aims to enhance students' comprehensive understanding of the logistics system and professional logistics simulation technology through the widespread use of those methods.

articleTitle: The Optimal Development of Water Resources in the Region Based on Fuzzy Optimization and Multi-Objective Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: This article focused on sustainable development, and proposed bounded conditions for reasonable use of water resources, then constructed the coordination and decomposition model. As the water resources have the multi-objectives, the first layer in the model put forward Multi-objective Genetic Algorithm, and use its unique ability of group research to make the optimal development of water resources simulate for biological evolution, It exist many ambiguous and uncertain problems because of the result based on different Decision-makers with his targets. Therefore, the second layer used fuzzy optimization. It greatly enhanced the accuracy and speed of the model. Experiments proved that we get the best coordinating relationships of utilizing the water resources and sustainable developed strategy.

articleTitle: Synthesis of Antenna Arrays Shaped-beam Using Mind Evolutionary Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Mind evolutionary algorithm (MEA) uses dasiasimilar taxispsila operation and dasiadissimilationpsila operation by imitating the human mind evolution to processes numerical optimization, overcoming the prematurity and improving searching efficiency. Given the determinate number and space between the antenna arrays units, the feeding-back amplitudes and phases are optimized and selected by this way to make the shaped-beam patterns satisfy the designing request. Computer simulations show that Mind Evolutionary Algorithm can be applied in optimization problems of uniformly-spaced linear array and the optimization result is better than that obtained from Genetic Algorithm.

articleTitle: Study on “Carnot Cycle” Teaching of Physical Chemistry Course
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: It is usually difficult for students to understand some theories in learning physical chemistry. A new teaching method was proposed that we should introduce the forming process and the research method (FPRM) of those theories to help them being understood. ldquoCarnot cyclerdquo teaching is analyzed as an example by FPRM method.

articleTitle: Research on Automatic Abstracting of WebPages Based on User-Demand
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Automatic abstracting is a practical and difficult branch in natural language processing, which becomes an important problem in some domains such as Internet information retrieval. This paper presents a new automatic abstracting method on the basis of traditional method, which adds the sentence weight based on user-demand into the sentence importance. The user-demand consists of the keywords that user queried. The experimental results show that this method can improve the accuracy of searching information.

articleTitle: Conceptual Design Knowledge Management System Based on Case and Constraint
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: This paper researches on knowledge management system in product conceptual design. System framework is supported. This system includes four modules. First, translating and decomposing userspsila design requirements using function-method tree. Second, using design case and constraint to describe the process of knowledge retrieval. One is to get the similarity of case function through matching function unitspsila attribute values which is weighted. Another is proposing a similarity constraint retrieval algorithm for similarity case retrieval. And then, Patch case is defined. Patch case for userpsilas design requirement is attained through a patch algorithm. Knowledge reuse and innovation is based on patch case. Four, knowledge retrieving from organization external is supported to knowledge base, case base and data base. At last, application example is constructed to explain this process.

articleTitle: OR-EM Method for Image Reconstruction in Cone-Beam CT
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Traditional CT reconstructions are limited by many kinds of artifacts, and they give dissatisfactory image. To reduce image noise and artifacts, we propose a statistical iterative method for image reconstruction in cone-beam CT. First the theory of maximum likelihood estimation is extended from emission CT to X-ray scan. Then an expectation-maximization (EM) formula is deduced for direct reconstruction of cone-beam CT. EM algorithm is an iterative method that can produce good quality reconstruction. But compared with fast and robust FDK algorithm, EM algorithm is computer intensive and convergence slow. In order to accelerate the convergence speed of EM algorithm, over relaxation (OR) is applied in this work. OR-EM algorithm is a feasible iterative method. It can provide good quality reconstructions after only a few iterations. Experiments results with computer simulated data and real CT data show OR-EM algorithm is effective. Its reconstructed images are accurate and clear.

articleTitle: A Survey of Bisimulation Semantics for Mobile Processes
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: In this paper, we study various bisimulation relations in the pi-calculus. The relationships, such as the strict inclusion and the coincidence, between the bisimulations are presented. We also provide counter-examples to show those strict inclusions.

articleTitle: Analysis of Peasant Worker's Vocational Training Aspiration - Applying “Social Cognitive Career Theory”
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: China is a traditional agricultural country, so Chinese education issue should be also concerned with rural people. Compared with degree education, vocational training is more suitable to rural place. But how to design a peasant satisfied training plan is the problem which is not yet be solved. Here this paper just makes efforts in this issue. In this paper, the author comprehensive use SCCT theory and binary logistic regression, to find some significant factors which can affect their aspirations. Base on these finding, at the end of this paper, the author give some suggestions to the plan design of vocational training for peasant workers.

articleTitle: Randomization in Logic System Ln
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: By means of randomization, the concept of randomized truth degree of well-formed formulae in n-valued Lukasiewicz propositional logic is introduced. It is proved that the set of values of randomized truth degree of well-formed formulae has no isolated point in [0, 1]. It is generalize the related concepts and properties of quantitative logic. The concepts of compatibility and independence of formulae are introduced and studied.

articleTitle: The Establishment of Logistics Training Platform Based on SCM
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Based on the concept of supply chain management (SCM), the paper puts forward the design objectives and function structure of logistics training platform, introduces the main characteristics and technical lines, and describes the main functions of training platform that can be achieved through hardware and software platform. The establishment of the integrated training platform discussed in this paper provides an innovative practical model for students majoring in logistics management in application-oriented institutions and the vocational colleges.

articleTitle: A Parallel Relaxed Multisplitting Method for Affine Second-Order Cone Complementarity Problem
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: The affine second-order cone complementarity problem (SOCCP) is a wide class of equilibrium optimization problems that contains the linear complementarity problem (LCP) as a special case. In this paper, a parallel relaxed multisplitting method for the affine SOCCP is developed and analysed. This method makes use of a set of different splittings of the coefficient matrix. The global convergence theories and the convergence rate are established for the proposed method.

articleTitle: Hybrid Transmission for Correlated MIMO Relay Channels
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: To improve the capacity of a correlated MIMO channel, we propose a hybrid transmission (HT) scheme that mixes half-duplex decode-and-forward relaying transmission with direct transmission (DT). Precoding and decoding schemes are considered to convert the original relay channel into several parallel subchannels so that resource allocation can be easily performed. Simulation results show that significant capacity gain can be achieved by the HT scheme compared to the DT scheme.

articleTitle: On the Practical Teaching of Information-Based Enterprise Management
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: The experiment of practical course teaching of information-based enterprise management has been summarized in this paper. The aims of the practical course are to cultivate the students to build the conceptual framework and systematical understanding of the information-based enterprise management, to promote the students' comprehension on the behavior of enterprise management from their individual life experience and to train the students learning to solve problems in the enterprise management by using tools of computer and application software. The major approach is to arouse the imagination and creativity of the students to set their course study objects. With the object of solving problems in enterprise management, the students adequately use the Web resource, search the informationization tools and learn to apply them to information-based enterprise management. Through the practical course, the integrated ability of using tools to solve problems has been increased. The methodology of PDCA has been used in the process of course teaching and nicer effect has been acquired.

articleTitle: Academic Emotions and Its Teaching Strategies in CAI
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Based on data from 933 Chinese adolescents and self-developed questionnaire of academic emotions, the structure of adolescentpsilas academic emotions was examined. Results showed that the adolescents often experience six kinds of emotions in learning activities: boredom, fear, sadness, happiness, anxiety and surprise. Taking fear and happiness as example, we propose teaching strategies to reduce fear and increase happiness in CAI.

articleTitle: Application of Virtual Realization System in Teaching of Conservancy and Hydropower Construction Course
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: The conservancy and hydropower construction course is considerably difficult for understanding and learning. It is teeming with specific items, abstractive concepts, complicated relations and engineering drafts. Lacking of engineering concepts and experience will increase the difficulties for undergraduates to learn it. With rapid development of computer graphics, researches on Virtual Reality technology have boomed accordingly in many fields to provide a real or simulative environment with feeling of self participations. The VR technology could also work well in the teaching of conservancy and hydropower construction. In this paper, 2 study cases were given to demonstrate its performance in our classes in some extent.

articleTitle: Mining Valid Association Rules in Incomplete Information Systems
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Extracting the association rules is an important research topic among the various data mining problems. Based on the rough set theory which is a powerful tool in dealing with incompleteness and uncertainty, an algorithm to mine association rules in incomplete information systems is presented. In the new algorithm, the support and confidence are redefined and a new judgment criterion is introduced in. The algorithm can mine the positive, invalid and negative association rules directly without processing missing values. The experiment shows that the new algorithm has short execution times, and can mine effective association rules efficiently.

articleTitle: The Application of Global Data Envelopment Analysis in the Disruption Management
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: The increasing disasters have led to the development of the disruption management. It is important to attempt to measure the relative efficiency of the input and output, which are from a group of nearly homogeneous departments in the disruption. The global data envelopment analysis (GDEA) methodology enables to aggregate performance results in order to obtain an overall performance measure through the comparison of a group of decision units. This paper conducts an application of the GDEA methodology, which evaluates the performance of the fire succoring of coal mine. The indicators concern both the fire and medical activities. The results reveal that those departments more efficiently carry out these activities.

articleTitle: Empirical Research on Difference of Organizational Climate for Innovation among Enterprises with Different Market Share in China
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Climate for innovation is an important factor for organizational innovation. On the basis of our prior research which indicated that organizational innovative climate in china include seven dimensions, such as working environment, organizational support, organizational vision, leadership support, team support, resources, learning growth and knowledge & skill, we use survey research to explored the difference of organizational climate for innovation in the innovation-oriented enterprises with different market share. The results suggested that there are significant differences among different relative market share enterprises groups in seven dimensions of climate for innovation. The conclusion will help us understand the status quo of organizational climate for innovation in China better.

articleTitle: An Approximating Fair Congestion Control Scheme at Core Network
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Congestion is a natural phenomenon in core network, and is unavoidable if the queuing system is operated near capacity. Providing fairness among users with different levels of aggressiveness, and different levels of responsiveness is necessary for efficient network flow control. The scalability of current solutions depends on the number of active flows and the number of flows whose rate is greater that the current fair share. In this paper we propose a new fair active queue management scheme, called SDP (selective differentiated penalization), that use the recent buffer resources allocation history to differentially penalize misbehaving flows by dropping more of their packets to make a tradeoff between scalability and fairness. The first principle of SDP is that the resulting throughput of each flow should be bounded by the max-min fair share bandwidth. The performance of SDP is aided by the fact that the recent history of buffer resource allocations can provide accurate rate estimates of active flow and the fair share threshold. Simulated results suggest that SDP provides a reasonable degree of max-min fair bandwidth allocation in a wide variety of operating conditions.

articleTitle: Study on Alliance of Audit Interests Based on Analytic Network Process
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: In a rapidly changing economic environment, the action about the alliance of audit interests acted by certificated public accountant (CPA) and manager of the public company made a great loss for the Company owners, potential investors and the public. The credibility of Certified Public Accountants for the whole has been received unprecedented attention. And the action also brought new challenges for regulators to strengthen supervision and control. This paper gives a fresh model which is Analytic Network Process (ANP), we can use it to study how we can get out of the alliance of audit interests standing at new position and with a new perspective. And constructed the index system which impact auditors of the lack of professional ethics,using the advantage of Analytic Network Process, taking into account the various impacts between indexes. So that the evaluation of the results was more scientific and rational. At last,the advises were given for regulators to improve the current mechanism for incentives and punishment.

articleTitle: Research and Development of Teaching Management System Based on the Pattern of “Work Flow”
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: After carrying out comprehensive and systematic analysis of the situation of higher education quality, which is constrained by lack of teaching quality active self-restraint system, institutionalization and the guarantee system of whole-control, the author develops the teaching management system based on the ldquowork flowrdquo pattern. The author, first, in pace with the current educational background, analyzes the research necessity, feasibility and application prospects of the teaching management system based on ldquoworking flowrdquo pattern, then elaborates the train of thought on the system research and development, finally introduces the solutions to key problems in detail.

articleTitle: Design for Active Monitor System in Distance Learning Environments
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: The execution of course program and timetables in distance learning systems is more strict in military school, it imposes necessity for teachers to guarantee the progress of students according with a set of course program by monitoring the studentspsila behaviors and giving the alert when the predefined schedules are violated in such an e-learning situation. An active monitor system is designed to improve the adherence to course programs for distance learning. Based on the tracking system responsible for collecting the attendance records on-line, the system acts as a global monitor detecting the learning activities of a student and reacts to the events mismatching with the course programs in order to control the learning evolution. The key part of the agent is a constraint-based self-adaptive scheduling module which is used to dynamically adjust the current course schedules according to the evolution of its execution. Finally the warning messages are translated into semantically meaningful sentences through causal information analysis.

articleTitle: Promoting the Fostering and Developing Student's Comprehensive Practice Capacity through Undergraduate Mechanical Innovational Design Competition
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Focusing on the issues of studentspsila practice capacity development in high school education, the author discussed the function and significance of studentspsila comprehensive practice capacity in the hierarchy systems of their capacity, two critical components and five dimensions of comprehensive practice capacity were proposed accordingly. Then, from two substantial aspects of capacity fostering respectively, which are improving the effects of knowledge transferring during educating and motivating studentspsila activeness to practice, the relationship between fostering and developing of studentspsila comprehensive practice capacity and encouraging students to participate in undergraduate mechanical innovative design competition (UMIDC) was addressed deeply. Finally, some issues which were liable to be neglected during the instructing of studentspsila practice, such as making students become the main participants of innovative practice and helping students to form the comprehensive quality of practice were identified, and the author provided some corresponding advice to it.

articleTitle: Study and Application of an Improved Particle Swarm Optimization in Job-Shop Scheduling Problem
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: The job-shop scheduling problem (JSP) is a classical NP-hard. The traditional methods solving it have their own Advantages and shortcomings. The powerful information processing capabilities of immune system provides people enlightenment for its artificial application. As a result, immune algorithm has emerged, and gradually been applied to many engineering practices. Due to the stubborn nature of the JSP, a new method based on immune particle swarm algorithm (IPA) is initially brought forward to solve job-shop scheduling problem. In this method, the IPA flow structure is presented via combining the immune theory and the particle swarm algorithm. The encoding method based on operation is used by IPA. And operator is designed according to vaccination, variation and immune selection. Finally, the simulation result shows that the IPA has good performance in job-shop scheduling problem.

articleTitle: Research on Inquiry-Collaborative Learning of Tourism Economics Course Based on E-learning Environment
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Based on Web resource, this paper used the action and evaluation methods to research teaching reform on Web-based self-directed of tourism economics in e-learning environment. The organizing and designing of teaching adopted Web-enhanced teaching mode. The experiments of our research not only supported its action plan, but also testified the feasibility, as well as collected data by class observation, interview and questionnaire.

articleTitle: The Analysis and Reform of the Distance Education in China's Rural Areas
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Urbanization is the strategic decision made by Chinese government at the turning of the new century. In a short span of six years, the urbanization in China has undergone considerable development. However, there has been a series of problems haunting us with the further development of urbanization. The paper begins with the issues caused by urbanization and explores its deep cause, and proposes the political recommendation from the rural education.

articleTitle: The Application of Keystone Concept Map in Scientific Research and Teaching
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: As the application of concept map and collaborative learning in the teaching & learning is increasing, this paper discusses the application of keystone concept map in scientific research and teaching. Firstly, it introduces the signification of concept map and collaborative learning in the teaching-learning and the development of the current concept mapping software. Then it compares the functions of various concept map software and describes the advantages of keystone concept map. Finally it discusses the application of keystone concept map from many points of view such as single-user mapping, multi-user mapping and learning-by-chapter as well as the thematic study. Moreover, it analyzes the features of this teaching mode.

articleTitle: Senior Physics Teaching Strategies Based on the Students' Learning Style
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: How to make different qualifications children through the learning to master the spot line and surface and to establish the system of knowledge in the review lessons during high three? Make the students of different styles to taste the physic knowledge is no longer cavity and difficult to understand, gain the relation between the correlations knowledge during the testing, understanding of knowledge has improved? In our view, first of all physics teacher must respect the laws of perception, in-depth understand each student's different learning style. Teachers should be aware of the differences of students' learning style, and improve the occasion, choose the teaching methods that suit to learnerpsilas learning, do to improve the effectiveness of teaching, according to ability to promote student learning.

articleTitle: Study of Content-Based Distribution Network Architecture
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Because different types of information contents have different requests for the QoS of transmission, the architecture of content-based distribution network (CBDN) is put forward in this paper. The network topology of CBDN is introduced. The working principle and key technologies of the architecture is explained in detail. According to the different requirements of the different types of information content, it adopts different transmission policy to schedule different transmission resources, so that the information, especially the survivable information are transmitted to the key locations in demands on time, on quantity and reliably.

articleTitle: A Local Indicator of Spatial Autocorrelation Based Sub-Area Algorithm for Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: To enhance management and cooperation of nodes in wireless sensor networks (simply WSNs), a local indicator of spatial autocorrelation (namely LISA) based sub-area algorithm, LISABSAA, is presented. Firstly, LISABSAA divides WSNs into spatial virtual grids, which are basic management units. According to LISAs of different spatial virtual grids, LISABSAA then divides WSNs into different areas by combining neighboring spatial objects. Experimental results show that LISABSAA can efficiently sub-area WSNs by LISABSAA.

articleTitle: The Implementation of Dynamic Linking in Dynamic Binary Translation Systems
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Dynamic binary translation (DBT) is a commonly used technology in virtual machines. Most DBT systems, like Dynamo, can only translate programs statically linked but not ones dynamically linked. Statically linked programs will lead to expansion of binary codes, which is the indirect reason of loss on performance. In this paper, we propose an approach to implement dynamic linking on DBT systems. During the research, we came across some challenges related with operating systems, compilation and architecture, which will be discussed later in detail. And we have developed a module and had it tested on our DBT system, CrossBit. The statistics show that CrossBit with dynamic linking reduces the number of translated blocks and execution time.

articleTitle: Analysis of Polynomial FM Signal Based on Wavelet-Reassignment Method
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Aiming on the problem of low precision and crossterm in the conventional method of in analyzing polynomial FM signal. The method that based on wavelet transform and time-frequency reassignment is proposed. Not only overcomes the contradiction between the crossterms of polynomial FM signal and the approximate time-frequency centering, but also is good at reducing noise. In this paper, the principle and application of wavelet-reassignment are summarized, and the polynomial FM signal analysis method is made based on the wavelet-reassignment and other methods. The simulation results show that the novel method has compositive advantages.

articleTitle: Recognition Essential Protein Based on Multi Parameters Combination
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: For the low recognition degree of essential protein based on topological parameter, the correlation between the essentiality of proteins and their main topological parameters is analyzed and the nature of the essentiality-judgment ability of the parameters is explored firstly. Then, the mutual information of essential node these parameters contain is brought out in virtue of their correlation, based on which the construction method of combined parameter is put forwards. In deeper study, the recognition degree of a combined parameter is found to have close relations not only to the performances of the independent parameters it constructed from, but also to the correlation between these independent parameters, and a asynchronous algorithm based on parameters combination is proposed lastly. The results of the emulation are not only consistent to each other highly, but also show that the performance of the method is better than that of the others obviously.

articleTitle: Parameterized Fast Depth of Field Effect
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Based on the thin-lens imaging model in geometric optics, we present a parameterized imaging effect model on graphics processor units, which needs only one pass model rendering and one pass post-processing. This model can be used to implement fast depth of field effect on a given model without changing any original code. The experiment demonstrates that our post-processing model costs only from 0.2 ms to 0.4 ms under general hardware conditions.

articleTitle: Study on Construction of Multinational Corporation's Global Learning Capability Based on Value Network
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: This article applies the knowledge-based theory of firm to discuss the firmpsilas learning capability, an original source of its competitive advantage in the era of knowledge economy. Multinational Corporation can enhance its global learning capability from the respective of the value network, a new strategic pattern adapting to the external knowledge economy environment. And the article also puts forward five measures for the multinational corporation to improve its global learning capability.

articleTitle: MMAP System Transfer in Linux Virtual Memory Management
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: MMAP system transfer has a very important effect in Linux virtual memory management, but its work process is not well-known. The paper is focus on this point, analyses system transfer functions, and offer system flow chart at last.

articleTitle: Land Suitability Research Based on GIS: Case from Hangzhou, China
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Land suitability is the base of land use planning and decision, especially in urban region. Current research is limited in suitability of single land use type or evaluation of unidirectional factorspsila influences, such as factors of geology environment, location & economic, or geochemistry, etc.. This article focuses on Hangzhou urban area land use suitability evaluation, in which construction land suitability and agro-land suitability are considered comprehensively, math models and GIS technology have been utilized. Applications and analysis of the weakness and superiority of models such as K-mean cluster, fuzzy comprehensive evaluation, BP neural net, have been studied during evaluation. The land use and urban expansion decisions are made upon the comprehensive evaluation of multi-land-utility and upon the least cost of high-quality ecological resources. GIS application and different math models for land suitability evaluation have been studied and application of land suitability evaluation conclusion on urban expansion planning has been discussed deeply in Hangzhou case.

articleTitle: Study of the Distance Learning in the New Countryside Construction
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: The human being is the key issue to the new countryside construction. The essence of the ldquothree agricultural problemsrdquo is the peasant problem. Developing education in order to cultivate the literate peasants is the way that must be followed. By the nature of its characteristics and advantages, the distance learning plays an important role in this construction process.

articleTitle: Analysis and Design of the College Computer-Aided Instruction System Based on CAI and ICAI's
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: This paper introduced and described the status quo and goal of current Chinese colleges and universities computer assistant teaching systems from many aspects, such as explore the background, design goal, information sharing, design features, technical characteristics and environment.

articleTitle: Conquering the Challenges Faced with Higher Engineering Education in New Era through Improving the Effect of Knowledge Transferring in Educating
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: With the development of university education and the evolution of the characteristics of the requirement to engineering graduates with high quality from entire society, the engineering education in University and college is concerned extensively and deeply by researchers of academic institutes and executives from enterprises at present. From the perspective of knowledge management in high school educating, the author inspected the process of knowledge transferring in todaypsilas university engineering education. The analysis was focused on the processes of knowledge transmission and studentspsila knowledge acquisition, which are opposed and inter depended to each other at the same time, several typical imperfections in the process of knowledge transfer but always been neglected in todaypsilas university engineering education were identified, and some responding measures were proposed, which is based on the authorpsilas teaching practice.

articleTitle: An Approach for Checking Resource Feasibility of Workflow Specifications
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: In addition to process perspective, resource perspective is also important for workflow models. It is crucial to detect the potential resource conflicts at build-time to prevent their actual emergence at run-time. In this paper, we define the resource feasibility of workflow specifications and proposed an approach to detect the potential resource conflicts take into account the resource type and amount as well as the time constraints. We represent the time constraints through lifecycle time lines which depict the lifecycle of each activities.

articleTitle: Generation and Extension of Linear Network Coding at Different Multicast Rates
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: By studying the intrinsic mechanism of linear network coding, this paper proposes a concept of generation and extension between two coding schemes at different multicast rates. We find out that a coding scheme at lower multicast rate is a generation of one at higher multicast rate,and a coding scheme at higher multicast rate is an extension of one at lower multicast rate. Moreover, we find out a determinate relationship between channels’ global encoding vectors under two generation-extension coding schemes. Furthermore, by combining with random linear network coding, several important properties are derived, which are helpful to implement linear network coding for single-source multicast network. Some related applications are enumerated.

articleTitle: Teaching Reform of Information Security Curriculum of Distance Learning
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Information security is becoming more and more important in recent years. It covers fruitful contents and still in rapid continuous changes. How to teach information security is a challenge to universities. Distance learning can provide a favorable environment to information security. An information security curriculum of distance learning has been designed in Zhejiang University. Distance learning curriculum has its own features and then it is different in curriculum design. In this paper, we will describe our curriculum design and share our experiences in teaching reform. In our curriculum, the teaching reform helps us boost our design and improve our teaching.

articleTitle: Research of Active Information Service System Based on Intelligent Agent
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: The current active information service system focuses too much on the study of personalized modeling, and there is less research on artificial participation, automatic information analysis and automatic information update. According to the requirement of active information service to topical web, the article integrate agent technology, information filtering technology, crawling technology on Heritrix and the technology of web information extraction on HtmlParser ,based on which a model that describes Active Information Service System based on Intelligent Agent is presented. The model embeds the intelligent agent technology, on one hand, it could accomplish four active functions, they are active information collection, active webpage parsing, active information filtering, active information publishing, on the other hand, it has intelligence to a certain degree and has some learning abilities in parsing module. The characteristic of the model is its flexibility and adaptive capability.

articleTitle: Based on Statistics of the Gradients the Feature Matching Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: The feature matching is the first step of several computer vision duties. In this paper we provide a new feature detect and matching approach based on statistics of the gradients of the feature region. It is extension of the sift algorithm. The algorithm represented in this paper can be used to perform reliable matching to image sequence, which have larger change in 3D viewpoint and change in illumination. The new approach not only describes the local region structure but also statistic orientation histogram of periphery twelve 5X5 sample sub-region. The constructed descriptor has more robust distinguishability to support the following match step. In the matching step, by using polar, symmetry and uniqueness constraints to filter the tentative feature pairs, many outliers are eliminated and the correct feature pairs are obtained in the last step. By comparing with traditional Harris--Correlation matching algorithm as well as theoretical analysis, the algorithm that this article proposed has the higher stability as well as the anti-jamming.

articleTitle: An XML-Based Approach for Chinese Character Glyph Description
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: The central problem presenting in current Chinese character glyph descriptions is the standard character set canpsilat cover all possible Chinese characters, some particular variants of characters that are ldquounifiedrdquo also canpsilat describe and display. As a database language based on XML, Character Description Language (CDL) can help resolve both of the difficulties just mentioned. This paper presents the key features and syntax of the language, and discusses some of its applications, especially to learning and recognizing Chinese characters.

articleTitle: LAppDesigner: The Design of a Database Application Customizing Tool Based on Linux
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Due to the problem of the often changes of users' requirements leading to many modifications of code, on basis of several technologies such as visual development, Persistent object and design patterns, using object-oriented analysis and design and development methods, we design LAppDesigner (Linux Application Designer): the database application customizing tool based on Linux driven by database with functions of visual customizing and dynamic making of simple database application, to create prototype system adapting to limited changes of userpsilas requirements. We implement most of functions of LAppDesigner in this paper by using development tool Delphi for Linux.

articleTitle: Empirical Analysis of Technical Efficiency of Chinese Coal Industry on Frontier Production Function
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: The technical efficiency for the coal industry of China has been estimated in this paper. A stochastic frontier production function on frontier production function has been used for the purpose. Panel data from the coal industries for the year 2006 have been used for empirical estimations. Making use of the software package Eviews 5.0, the model has been estimated by the least squares method. The overall average technical efficiency is estimated to be 0.51 for the coal industry of China. The empirical results suggest the average efficiency is low. Thus improving the efficiency of coal industry is one of the current important problems.

articleTitle: Integration of Featured Specialty Construction and Featured Course Construction in Higher Education - With a Case Study of China Jiliang University
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Universities in China are facing harsh competitions for their graduates' employment in a labor market which was lagging behind the development of the universities, and it's  becoming important for specialties and courses to have their own unique features so as to win a competitive edge in a fierce market. Therefore, featured specialty construction and featured course construction have been given much attention in recent years, but so far the researches and practices have almost all been conducted on only one of these. This paper analyzes the relationship of the two, and puts forward the concept of integration of featured specialty construction and featured course construction, and gives an example to support the main idea of this paper, which is the practices of the State-level Featured Specialty "Measurement & Technology and Instrumentation" in China Jiliang University and its State-level Excellent Course "Sensor Technology", including the techniques they adopted to become successful.

articleTitle: An Advertisement Fee Model for Direct Mail Decision Support System
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Nowadays many corporations have used advertisement decision support system, which can be used to help people make scientific, reasonable advertisement planning and marketing work. Direct mail (DM) is a popular advertisement means, however there lacks DM advertisement fee model in those advertisement decision support system. Thus it is necessary for bookshop to build a DM advertisement fee model that can help its manager make the decision on the optimized advertisement fee and obtain maximized profit of the bookshop. To solve the above problem, a brief analysis and three hypotheses on advertisement fee model of DM are given firstly, then the aforementioned fee model is modeled and relational solution is proposed. Finally conclusion and further research issues are presented.

articleTitle: Organizational Management in the Specialization Process of E-Learning
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: The objective of this study is to evaluate whether specialization has an impact on the E-Learning of universities. We identified organizational management dimension as our research site. With access to the teachers and staff members of E-Learning program, we obtained both qualitative and quantitative data from five universities for our factor analysis to define which variables are important, the results will help scholars formulate future research.

articleTitle: High-Precision and Fixed-Point Discrete Cosine Transform without Multiplications
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Discrete Cosine transform (DCT) is an important tool in digital signal processing. In this paper, based on our previous work of performing DCT via linear sums of discrete moments, we have made development to eliminate multiplications in discrete Cosine transforms by performing appropriate bit operations and shift in binary system, which can be implemented by integer additions of fixed points. An efficient and regular systolic array is designed to implement it, and the complexity analysis is also given. Different to other fast Cosine transforms, our algorithm can deal with arbitrary length signals and get high precision. The approach is also applicable to multi-dimensional DCT and DCT inverses.

articleTitle: Controlling Model for the Hotspots in Peer-to-Peer Networks
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Hotspots could degrade the performance of peer-to-peer (P2P) systems and add vulnerability to the system. This paper researches into the hotspots in P2P network, and present a new method to avoid generating the hotspots in the network by controlling the logical topology structure of P2P network. We firstly introduce the controlling ideas about seeking for spare nodes of the hotspots and distributing them into super-cube structure. Then, we disclose and interpret the controlling model, and give out the controlling algorithm. Finally, we validate our controlling model via simulations and the simulation results demonstrate that our work is effective to control the hotspots in P2P network. Thus, this model can improve the network competence to defend against coordinated attacks, promote the network robustness, and ensure the network would develop continually and healthily.

articleTitle: Parallel Framework for Real-time DSP Implementation of EBC Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: JPEG2000, the state-of-the-art image compression standard, has many advantages, such as high compression efficiency and high image fidelity. However, because of its high computational complexity, real-time hardware implementation of JPEG2000 becomes a big problem when using it in deadline constrained applications. EBC algorithm is the main part of JPEG2000 which comprises more than 50% of the computational complexity. Aiming at the shortcut of the EBC framework which is not suitable for the establishment of DSP software pipeline, a parallel framework for real-time DSP implementation of EBC algorithm is proposed in this paper. The original bit-plane coding module is firstly partitioned into bit-plane scanning module and arithmetic coding module. Then the sign coding is separated from the bit-plane scanning module and implemented ahead. And the multiple loops of the bit-plane scanning module are unrolled with context combining. By these optimizations, the software pipeline of the EBC algorithm can be established which leads to an eight-time faster implementation speed.

articleTitle: A Probe into the Evaluation Strategies to Facilitate Students' Interaction and Autonomous Learning in CET
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: In college English teaching (CET), evaluation is not only to check the results of learning but also a strategy to reform teaching model. The focus in the article is placed on the formative evaluation strategies to facilitate studentspsila interaction and autonomous learning. The principle of Criterion First and the evaluation interpretation strategies--- student team achievement division (STAD) and integration of group achievement and individual contribution---are elaborated. The research reveals how the strategies work effectively to enhance studentspsila self-confidence and interests in learning, drive them to study actively and purposefully, and reinforce the studentspsila self-discipline and self-supervising.

articleTitle: E-learning Methods and Hindering Factors for their Usage: An Empirical Study in an Education Institute
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: E-learning technology has been widely used in the academic institutes, to support the effectiveness and efficiency of the students' learning and the educators' teaching. However, how much the students community make a use of the e-learning technology, what type of e-learning methods are being mainly used by the students, as well as the barriers for enjoying the advantages of e-technology from the studentspsila aspect, remain an interesting topic for the educators to explore. This paper, by focusing on these issues, through a survey among the students within a higher education institute, presents some understanding regarding the usage of e-learning technologies, and the factors hindering the efficacy of the usage of E-methods.

articleTitle: Association Rule Mining of Lithology Analysis in Three Gorges
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Three Gorges are the south area which is thickly covered by soil and flourish vegetation and the lithology analysis is very difficult. There is also no mature method on this aspect. Three Gorges possess the characters of complicated terrain, frequent geologic disasters and full-grown vegetation and soil, so it is very important to make lithology analysis in the area. In the paper we made analysis of lithology with remote sensing images aiming at the area of Three Gorges, adopted the idea of oriented-object, built three sorts of guideline sets of spectrum, texture and vegetation covering, made quantification of the guideline sets and based on the algorithm of concept grid mined the associated rules of the lithology in the stratums of Three Gorges: Jia Second and Third Sections Jia Ling River Group T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>j<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>j<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>, Ba First and Second Sections Ba Dong GroupT<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>b<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup> and T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>b<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, and Da Ye Group T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>d.

articleTitle: Use P2P for Online Transaction and Electronic Marketplace
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: While P2P technology is mainly used in delivering digital content, we believe its characteristics are also suitable to be applied in constructing online electronic marketplace. The features such as low cost, high reliability and performance of P2P network could improve the services of online transaction which currently build on centralized architecture. In this paper, we analyze the desired features of P2P network in designing distributed electronic marketplace and examine their advantages over conventional approaches. Obviously, many works remains before broadly adopting P2P technology for online transactions. What we did is trying to provide a foundation for designing such platform, and we hope our work is helpful for further research on P2P's application in business area.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Self-Help Web Based Course
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Using the originality of Self-help Web Site that presented on commercial web site for reference, a new kind of web based course named Self-help Web Based Course was designed and implemented. Self-help Web Based Course provided a quick and easy way for teachers to perfect and update the content of course. Teachers can edit the web page online easily without manipulating the source code. Thus, the content of course can be updated timely, and the quality of web based course will be guaranteed.

articleTitle: Delay-Quantization and Augmented Controller Vector Method of Networked Control Systems Modeling
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: For the dynamic output feedback control problem over networks, when the control network is only inserted between the controller nodes and the actuator, delay-quantization and augmented controller vector method is applied and a discrete-time Markov jump system model is established. Then, the stabilization controller design method is presented. Finally, the simulation on a cart and inverted pendulum is made. Since the delay-quantization method is applied to the system, the model established and the design method proposed are fit for solving dynamic output feedback control problem with Markov delays, and are also fit for solving dynamic output feedback control problem with known distribution stochastic delays.

articleTitle: Study on Logistics Center Location Judgment Based on Artificial Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Logistics center location influenced by various indictors is crucial to logistics planning. According to 21 evaluation index, this paper established the reliable artificial neural network mode and made decision research on logistics center location. The result of the example showed that compared with multi-class fuzzy comprehensive evaluation, artificial neural network model possesses the characteristics such as quantity analysis and accuracy etc, and is suitable for logistics center location.

articleTitle: A Novel Text Clustering Method Based on TGSOM and Fuzzy K-Means
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: According to the high-dimensional sparse features of the storage of the textual document, and defects existing in the clustering methods which havealready studied by now and some other problems, an effective text clustering approach (short for TGSOM-FS-FKM) based on tree-structured growingself-organizing maps (TGSOM) and Fuzzy K-Means (FKM) is proposed. It firstly makes preprocess of texts, and filter the majority of noisy words by usingunsupervised feature selection method. Then it used TGSOM to execute the first clustering to get the rough classification of texts, and to get the initial clustering number and each text’s category. And then introduced LSA theory to improve the precision of clustering and reduce the dimension of feature vector. After that it used TGSOM to execute the second clustering to get the moreprecise clustering result, and used supervised feature selection method to select feature items. Finally, it used FKM to cluster the result set. In the experiment, it remained the same number of feature items.Experimental results indicate that TGSOM-FS-FKM clustering excels to other clustering method such as DSOM-FS-FCM, and the precision is better thanDSOM-FCM, DFKCN and FDMFC clustering.

articleTitle: Using Ontology to Support Portlet Semantic Interoperability
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: This paper discusses the needs of the portlets' semantic interoperability. It shows the drawbacks of current specifications of portlets such as JSR168 and WSRP. The paper suggests using ontology to support semantic interoperability of portlets. It proposes a scheme of ontology as a remote portlet service to illustrate the semantic interoperability of portlets.

articleTitle: Biologically Inspired Class-Specific Codebook Construction
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Aiming at class-specific recognition tasks, a novel method is presented to improve the object recognition performance of a biologically inspired model by learning class specific feature codebook. The feature codebook is multi-class shared in the original model, and the content proportion for different codeword type is set in uniform distribution.According to corresponding discriminability, we modify the codebook content proportion for different codeword types(feature vector sizes and filter scales). The test results demonstrate that the codebooks built with proposed modification achieve higher total-length efficiency.

articleTitle: Grey Evaluation Model of Students' Teaching Experiment Grades
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: The paper discusses the significance of training new military personnel to accelerate the development of navy weapon and equipment system. In order to cultivate more new military personnel, it is an important part to enhance the teaching quality in practical process. Meanwhile, to effectively evaluate students' learning effect in practical process is also the important measure to cultivate personnel with innovation spirit. In accordance with the synthetic evaluation problem of students' experiment performance, taking into account various factors that influence experiment grades, avoiding many disadvantages brought about from the conventional examination, we established the evaluation system, and carried out synthetic evaluation of studentspsila experiment grades by adopting the "grey system theory", establishing the "grey evaluation model", and programming with MATLAB. The grey evaluation model followed the following steps: At first, the evaluation index is defined. Secondly, the weight vectors are determined. Thirdly, evaluation sample matrix is formed. Fourthly, the gray categories of evaluation are determined and the grey evaluation modulus is calculated. In the final stage, overall evaluation value are calculated and put in sequence. A case study in Dalian Naval Academy is provided to demonstrate the application of this method. The finding clearly indicates that the grey evaluation model may successfully evaluated students' comprehensive learning capacity.

articleTitle: An Appraisal on Customer Depth Cooperation Result Based on Fuzzy Valuation
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Appraises on customerpsilas cooperation system result often needs to observe many operating indexes. In fact, the most difficult point of customerpsilas cooperation result computation and the appraisal is the multi-objective of customerpsilas cooperation system. Regarding the kind of multivariable space point, itpsilas very difficult to compare its fit and unfit quality directly. Therefore, this paper, based on AHP method, tries to resolve the key issues of the effective calculation and evaluation process between customerpsilas cooperation with the composite fuzzy evaluation of fuzzy measures and fuzzy integral theory.

articleTitle: Research on the Fuzzy Comprehensive Quality Evaluation Method of the Research Oriented Courses of the Higher Vocational Colleges
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: The paper firstly introduces the characteristics of higher vocational research oriented courses, and analyzes the deficiency of the common methods used for evaluating the quality of the courses at present. Based on this, more scientific, comprehensive and objective multi-level fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method based on fuzzy theory is brought forward. At the same time, aiming at the characteristics of higher vocational research oriented courses, evaluation index system and weight assigning scheme are designed, and course quality index evaluation matrix is established and put into utility.

articleTitle: The Brief Analysis of the Teaching Quality Enhance Way in Project Management
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: The project management is the important branch under the management science, it specialized the most important teaching profession that is quality of teaching, which has formed this article. This article unifies the project management talented person's knowledge level which full scale development request, and considers that after this college major come on the line post, the undergraduate course stage's quality of teaching was not only deciding the school prestige, but also deciding them for the social service level. Therefore, this article gave the necessity of the proof project management and put forward several proposals to improve the quality of teaching.

articleTitle: Study on Regional Logistics Information Platform Based on Multi-Media Technology
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Development of Regional logistics information platform is a complicated system. Based on requirements analysis, a regional logistics information platform is developed in the paper. In order to process the various media information during logistics operation, a multi-media database is designed. The platform has a hierarchy structure, and includes such five levels as physical, technical, data, functional, and service. The application of multi-media technology and data mining is a guarantee to make full use of the logistics information platform.

articleTitle: Branching Temporal Qualitative Coalitional Games with Preferences
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Qualitative Coalitional Games (QCGs), as a variation of coalitional games, is to investigate agents' strategies and behaviors in cooperating games. Each agent has a set of goals as its desires and will be satisfied if at least one of its desires is achieved by executing some strategies in a coalition, otherwise be unsatisfied. After introducing QCGs, we add preference to QCGs framework to enable that every agent has the ability to join the best coalition for achieving its preferences goals. In order to make a formal description and reason about repeated coalitional games, the paper will study Branching Temporal Qualitative Coalitional Games with preferences. Computational Tree Logic (CTL) is used for QCGPs with complete axiomatisation of it, denoted as CTQCGPs. Further more, this paper analyses and proofs the expression power, Satisfiability and complexity of CTQCGPs.

articleTitle: Blast Furnace Measurement and Control System Based on Virtual Instrument
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: In this article, a blast furnace measurement and control system is introduced. It is based on the Labview development platform, and takes the ADAM4000 series data acquisition module of Advantech as the core. This system can replace the massive display instruments, finish monitoring the furnace conditions, and realize to manage the historical data.

articleTitle: Representing Learning Peer-Model Based on FOAF
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: The group formation is the precondition which ensures the success of computer-supported collaborative learning. The collaborative grouppsilas learning interest, goal, plan and effect will be affected by both the learnerpsilas relation network and the characteristic structure of learning group. How can peer-model in CSCL-environments be presented using FOAF with its expanded vocabularies is studied and a peer-model network framework based on FOAF is presented, both of which are based on peer-model with dynamic cooperative information. Our research will not only improve the organizing manner of CSCL and the efficiency of the collaborative learning but also has positive meaning to the foundation of virtual learning community in a collaborative learning setting.

articleTitle: Simulation Research on Braking Torque of Eddy Current Retarder
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Research on influence factor of braking torque of one kind of eddy current retarder under existing magnetic yoke effect. One hundred ninety-six simulations were carried out which seven air gap parameters, four coil parameters, seven current parameters were taken for simulating by using Maxwell software according to physical structure parameter of eddy current retarder under existing magnetic yoke effect. Effect relationships that current, air gap and coil number of windings to braking torque were obtained through regression analysis to data of having been obtained by using SPSS software, providing concise and reliable analysis and computational method for analyzing retarderpsilas structure and developing new product.

articleTitle: A Classification on Evaluation Indices of Network Culture Security in China - Based on a Survey of Group with High Academic Degrees
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Based on a survey on evaluation index system of network culture security (NCS), with an empirical analysis, this paper classifies the varied information concerning NCS and establishes the evaluation index system of NCS. It can provide evidences for establishing and progressing the laws and regulations of system of NCS, and for studying and developing the safeguard structure and the systematic platform of NCS.

articleTitle: Five Relationships of China Higher Engineering Education Based on the Interest-Driven
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: This paper will discuss five relationships of higher engineering education. Among them, teaching, research and social services are the three major functions of the higher engineering universities; professional education and humanities education, ability education and knowledge education, theoretical teaching and practical teaching are the goals of higher engineering education; development of education and development of national economy and regional economy involves the interaction between higher engineering universities and society. Furthermore, the five main parts are students,teachers, universities, employers and government. The driving force of the various interest of higher engineering education is analyzed thoroughly on the higher angle for guiding and enlightening the future development of China higher engineering education.

articleTitle: VRP Problem with Time Windows in the Logistics and Distribution Solved by Immune Ant Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Draw lessons from the immune mechanism of living beings and combine the principle that ants looking for food and put forward the immune ant colony algorithms to solve the logistics and distribution. Use immune mechanism to draw the vaccine while the ants search, and carry on immunity operation to the evolved population and raise the search ability and convergent of the ant colony algorithm to the optimum solve of the overall situation. It adopts the adaptive mutation, multiple point crossover, and the genetic tactic of protecting excellent between generations, it strengthens the stability and fast of evolution.

articleTitle: The Design and Research of Activity Instruction Based on LAMS
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Guided by the theory of activity instruction and based on the instruction platform of LAMS, this paper studies the application of the theory of activity the learning in teaching practice and puts it into practice. Firstly, there is a brief introduction of LAMS and its characteristics and correlative applications, bringing up the principles of activity instruction and its correlative teaching strategy. In the instructional design dissertation for the public class of education technology, the students can study by themselves and get personal experience while combining the activity theory with LAMS, This performance reaches a good result. Therefore, the readers will be expected to develop the instructional design in the theory of activity instruction and enrich ideas and methods in teaching practice.

articleTitle: Watermarking Based on Feature Points Detected in MPEG-2 Video
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: The applications of video on Internet or wireless networks become very popular nowadays. However, these digital contents can be easily modified and copied by end users. Hence copyright protection, copy protection and integrity verification have become important issues in recent years. This paper proposes a novel blind watermarking algorithm based on feature points detected in MPEG-2 video. In this algorithm, Corner is defined as feature point. The position of watermark embedded is decided by the corners which are found by using Harris Detectors. And then combined with MPEG-2, the watermark is embedded by adjusting the 8*8 block DCT's DC coefficient. The experimental results show that compared with the original video, the watermarked video sequence is changed slightly; the PSNR of watermarked frames loses a little. Especially the proposed algorithm has strong robustness towards frame deleting and MPEG-2 compressing.

articleTitle: Grain Production Control System Simulation Based on Simulink
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: China is the biggest agricultural country in the world, and agriculture continues to be the main economic activity. Itpsilas remarkable that China has been able to properly feed over one-fifth of the worldpsilas population with only one-fifteenth of the worldpsilas arable land. Therefore, China's grain production has always been concerned by the whole world. In this paper, we present the model of grain production control system implemented in MATLAB/SIMULINK. The aim of this study is to analyzing the Chinapsilas grain equilibrium from the point of view of state controllable policy. It contributes to provide quantitative reference and data support for decision-maker in grain forecasting, policy analysis and simulation.

articleTitle: Predictive PI Active Queue Management Based on Grey System
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: This paper proposed a novel predictive PI algorithm based on connotative type grey model. The predicted instantaneous queue errors, while not the sample values, are utilized to determine to packet drop rate in the router. This method aims to achieve the satisfactory trade-off between fast responsiveness and low overshoot. Simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the grey predictive PI active queue management scheme.

articleTitle: Analysis of OFDM Receiver with Insufficient Guard Interval
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: In this paper, we analysis the receiver of orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) systems over frequency selective fading channels where the multipath delay exceeds the guard interval duration and propose a novel receiver scheme. The proposed receiver consists of the Inter Symbol Interference (ISI) canceller and the turbo equalizer. At each iteration, the proposed turbo equalization algorithm performs soft Inter Carrier Interference (ICI) cancellation and frequency domain minimum mean-square error (MMSE) filtering to minimize the performance degradation caused by ICI distortion and frequency-selective channels. Simulation results of the system performance show that the proposed receiver effectively recovers the contaminated OFDM signals.

articleTitle: A Low-Cost Network Design of Practical Trainning Laboratory
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: In order to supplement the practical aspects of the lack of teaching resources, enable students to master the practical technology to form the computer network and improve the quality of the technical center staff and the level of network technology of teachers. The author put forward a project that makes full use of human resources and idle network Equipment in network technology center to build a low-cost practical laboratory.

articleTitle: On Synergetic Theory and Application in Sports Curriculum Reform
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
