abstract: The synergetic theory, an important systems science has already been applied widely in each domain, but it is used little in the sports curriculum reform. This research is about the application of synergetic theory together with information technology and computer technology in sports curriculum. Culture is the important foreword parameter to conduct the deep research which to explore one kind of new pattern in the sports curriculum reform.

articleTitle: SWSLP: A New SLP Model Based on Small World Net
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Chimney-like Directory Agent Service Location Protocol and mesh-connection Directory Agent mesh Service Location Protocol are the two main hybrid Service Discovery Mechanisms. However, it is reasonable to improve network performance by optimizing local unit size from the opinion of both sociology and network optimization. Based on the theory of "small-world network" of Watts and Strogatz, this paper presents a Small World Service Location Protocol model to improve the dependability of Service Discovery Mechanism. This method effectively improve the system reliability of Service Discovery Mechanism when facing to the failure of local Directory Agent scope by virtue of the reasonable collaboration a few long connections and a great deal short connections. The simulation study shows that Small World Service Location Protocol provides good service discoverability as compared to Service Location Protocol and mesh Service Location Protocol. At the same time, it offers less first respond time after DA scope failure under the failure of local Directory Agent scope with less network bandwidth.

articleTitle: The Study of Products' Basis of Tourism E-commerce
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: The suitable tourism products for the operation of e-commerce are the basis for the development of tourism e-commerce. Firstly, this paper theoretically explores the foundation of e-commerce network and the barriers of standardization for the development of tourism e-commerce products. Through studying China's current tourism e-commerce, it is found that the standardization is the main constraints for the development of tourism e-commerce. The basic solution is to break down the productspsila elements and formed the capacity of modular R & D production, which requires the joint efforts of administrative agencies, local governments and tourism enterprises.

articleTitle: A Multi-Criteria Interval Optimization Model for Manufacturing Supplier Selection Using Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: This paper presents a multi-criteria interval optimization model to determine the optimal criteria values and then rank the candidate suppliers. Evaluation criteria values are considered as interval data and the optimization model is constructed based on the concept of distance measure of the Euclidean distance and vector theories. It is proved that the optimization objective function must have an optimal solution and genetic algorithm based on integer encoding is applied to obtain it. The computational results of a practical example suggested the proposed model and approach is satisfactory and the final choice is obtained. Finally, encouraging conclusions are given.

articleTitle: Analysis of Transaction Behavior in B to C E-Commerce Based on Incomplete Information Game
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: With rapid development of e-commerce, in the B to C e-commerce transaction model, it has brought about a lot of convenience to consumers, at the same time some consumers were deceived, the reason of which is incomplete information for consumers. Operators transmit false information to consumers, and consumers can not identify, which greatly reduces the efficiency of the transaction network. In this paper adopts signaling game model to analyze the authenticity of the information of operators in e-commerce, and put forward strategies to reduce false information.

articleTitle: A Wireless Video Framework Based on RCPC and FEC
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: A framework of video transmissions over 3G wireless channels based on RCPC and FEC is proposed, which can cope with the bit error and packet loss occurred in transmission. The bit error model and packet loss model are used to estimate the bit error rate and packet loss rate, with which the RCPC code and FEC code is adjusted, and the datum are divided into the same length packet to be transmitted. The datum are unpacked, FEC coded and Viterbi decoded at the receiving terminal, then transmitted to video decoder to rebuild video signal, while some statistical informations including data packet loss rate, bit error rate, etc, are recorded in a network monitoring module at the receiving terminal, which are fed back to the sending terminal to control coding rate. The experiments show that the transmission framework can improve the received video quality in 3G wireless channels.

articleTitle: Web-Based Cooperative Learning and Application Solution Research
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Cooperative learning is one of the basic characters of independent creative learning, and network environment is an important means of promoting cooperative learning. This paper not only analyses the theory of Web-based cooperative learning, learning content and learning pattern, but also proposes relevant implement measures combining the course features of software analysis and design. It also gives the solutions to the problems that met in the implementation process. The result shows that the abilities of cooperation communication, innovation skills and learning enthusiasm of students are evidently improved.

articleTitle: A Survey of SCM System in Sports Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: In order to provide administrators of sports enterprises basic theoretical framework of thinking-modes and administrating decisions, this article, using modern advanced computer technology and information technology, considers internal and external integrated supply chain systems from supply chain systems of sports enterprises as well as supply chain management system.

articleTitle: Research on the Method and Its Improvement of MAS for Tourism E-commerce System
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Tourism e-commerce system still has many urgent problems that should be solved in China, in order to achieve its advantages of information, intelligence and others; the paper introduces the intelligent agent technology, and we build the MAS model based on this technology. It can collect various kinds of information initiatively and intelligently, according to the demands and interests of the customers, and finally customizes individualized best programs for the tourists. The paper also introduces an optimization of UML used in some parts simply, which is to enhance the visualization maneuverability of the system.

articleTitle: Routing in Large Scale-Free Network with Community Structure
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: The topology of a network has close connections with the performance of routing algorithms based on it. In this paper, we propose an evolving model named SNCS to characterize both scale-free property and community property of many communication networks simultaneously. Then, we build a traffic model based on SNCS and use a simple routing strategy to investigate the impact of community structure on traffic flow on SNCS. In order to maximize the throughput of a network, we put forward several routing strategies that take advantage of the knowledge of topological information of a network such as the degree of a node and the community structure of the network. Experimental results show that the modified routing algorithms are able to find more efficient routes to deliver packets and thus improve the efficiency of the network considerably as the strength of the community structure is increased.

articleTitle: Empirical Analysis on Specialized Education of Postgraduates
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Postgraduate education is not only the highest level of education, but an important part of research universities. The paper, in view of the postgraduates in economics and management of agricultural and forestry universities, investigates the specialized education of postgraduates. The paper draws conclusion through empirical analysis and suggests solutions to the problems.

articleTitle: The Research on Experience Teaching of Marketing Based on Constructivist Learning Perspective
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Because of much practicality of marketing education, experience teaching can effectively raise teaching efficiency. Based on the constructivist learning theory, which emphasizes active construction, situated construction and social construction of knowledge, this paper brings out the experience teaching pattern, analyses the difference between the experience teaching and the traditional teaching, and explores the specific ways of its application such as role-playing, case discussion, project assignments, entrepreneurship contest, out-of-school training and so on. Finally, this paper points out some matters which need be concerned.

articleTitle: Mapping Enterprise Process Measure into Information Model
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Collecting measure data play a key role in practicing enterprise process measure. For mapping measure to enterprise information system and collecting measure data automatically, it is necessary to provide a common method to define semantics of process measure and information model. The semantics structure of basic measure is an analyze at first. Based on domain ontology, a structure called semantic tree is defined to describe the semantics relationships among measured entity, measurable attribute and constrains. The structure is suitable for enterprise information model too. Arithmetic to computer the similarity of semantics tree is presented and a method to map measure and enterprise information model is put forward. These methods are the base of automatic process measure data collection and enterprise information integration.

articleTitle: Ontology-Based Intelligent Learning Behavior Analysis System Design for Online Learning
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Online learning is the primary object in today's digital learning environment, so analyzing learnerspsila online learning behaviors are necessary to development of online learning platforms and educational resources, to help teachers designing and organizing the curriculum, to guild learners studying more effectively. This paper constructs a intelligent online learning behavior analysis system based on ontology and semantic parsing, build the ontology base according to online learning behavior model and concepts relations in the online learning domain, extract metadata and semantic annotate data from the behavior information which we collected, match the semantic parsed data with ontology base to deduce learnerspsila learning effect and to evaluate learning process automatically. Expert can better to improve online learning platforms and resources based on this analysis system, it also make learnerspsila learning more effective.

articleTitle: A Study on Video Watermark Based-on Discrete Wavelet Transform and Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: In this paper, a DWT-based video watermark algorithm has been proposed to carry on three-DWT to the video frame after the scene analysis, the using of genetic algorithm to insert the watermark image that has-been scrambled by Arnold scrambling algorithm ensures the hidden data visually invisibility. Blind watermark algorithm is used when it extracts watermark image. The experimental results illustrate that the proposed watermarking algorithm is robust to video degradation attacks, such as noise, MPEG coding , frame dropping and frame swapping.

articleTitle: Research on Vector Map Digital Watermarking Technology
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: The classification and copyright protection of digital map were described in this paper. After the basic theories of digital watermarking were introduced, the technologies that have been used in vector map digital watermarking were analyzed, and its classification of algorithms was expatiated on. Finally the possible directions for further research were pointed out.

articleTitle: Examples of Using Computer Technology in Mathematics Education
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: This paper presents several examples of using computer technology to make teaching and learning mathematics more effectively and efficiently. These examples show that technology will allow teachers to lead much more in-depth discussions in class. The use of computer technology in classrooms may in general raise studentspsila interests in mathematics, and enhance their problem solving skills.

articleTitle: A Chinese-Learning Game Based on J2EE
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: With the tide of learning Chinese coming, we developed a Chinese-learning quiz game based on Java2 Platform, Enterprise Edition (J2EE), which is named for "root of Chinese characters" Chinese-learning game (RCCCLG). Using the B/S model, this game system combined the J2EE architecture with the Struts, the Spring and the Hibernate frameworks, and realized the model-view-controller (MVC) pattern which separated the page logic, business logic and data logic one another. Therefore a loosely coupled structure is achieved, enhancing the versatility, the maintainability, the extendibility of the system. Besides, the system can bring Chinese learners a great interest, make learning merge with entertainment, improve the learning efficiency and thus greatly reduce the difficulty of learning Chinese, especially for non-native speakers.

articleTitle: Design of a Hardware-in the Loop Experiment Simulation System for Process Control Based on RTW
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Based on the study of MATLAB/RTW function,a hardware-in the loop experiment simulation system is designed. In this platform, data transmission between practical process and MATLAB workshop was carried out by an I/O card supported by MATLAB, so that the practical system was imported to the simulation loop, the integration of system modelling, analysis, digital simulation and goal realization is realized. The teaching and research contents, just as automatic control technology, detecting element, actuating mechanism, controlled object and so on can be merged into one integral whole based on this platform, comprehensive experiments can be establish. In the end, an experiment taking the electric cup as the controlled object based on fuzzy control method is fulfilled. The simulation result shows that the system has good real-time performance, parameters can be modified on online .The platform can be widely used in control theory experimental teaching or control system design.

articleTitle: Research on Algorithm of Conflict Detection and Resolution in Free Flight Based on Genetic Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: The research background of free flight is discussed, the substance of the conflict detection and resolution in free flight based on genetic algorithms is studied, and a mathematical model is constructed in the paper. The emulation results of applications show that the genetic algorithms is suitable and positive to detect and resolute the conflict in free flight. The flight courses of aircrafts, which are as close as possible to the theoretical direct flight course of the least-fuel-consumption, can be generated by genetic algorithms.

articleTitle: Bilingual Teaching of Numerical Simulation Based on MATLAB
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Numerical simulation is a practical course combining engineering and computer using MATLAB which is overall English software for engineering computing. Based on practice and experiences of bilingual teaching the subject, the author summarize the ways of class bilingual teaching:, how to stimulate students, how to select the textbook, how to prepare for the class, how to balance using Chinese and English and so on.

articleTitle: The Speed Servo Control of Airborne Hydraulic Pump on the Condition of Existing Gear Backlash
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: In order to meet the high speed demand of the airborne hydraulic pump, speed increase gearbox is often used to increase the general motor's speed in the hydraulic testing bed. Gear backlash is always existed in the gear mesh and it will make the whole system have the strong nonlinear character. The whole system including nonlinear character is analyzed by using mathematic modeling. Predictive control based on neural network has been proposed to control the speed of the airborne hydraulic pump. The control result of the predictive control based on neural network has great superiority, which reduces the effect of gear backlash. The study results show that the system has good dynamic responsibility, good tracking performance and strong robustness.

articleTitle: Nine Steps to Shorten the Distance between Requirement Theory and Practice
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Requirement analysis is a critical but difficult part of software development. With the combination of various requirement analysis methods and practice, a method which carries out requirement analysis through nine steps is proposed. The establishment of three models, business model, preliminary data model and functional model, is the focus of the establishment of a target system. Such method has been applied in the development of a library information system and practice showed that such method is systematic, comprehensive and practical, shortening the distance between requirement analysis theory and practice.

articleTitle: A Multi-Party Contract Signing Protocol and its Formal Analysis in Strand Space Model
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Difficulties in designing multi-party contract signing (MPCS) protocols include providing concise and efficient protocols and at the same time keeping the protocols fair and abuse-free. This paper proposed an optimistic MPCS protocol. The number of rounds is reduced to two and the message transmission number to O(n2), which is the best known so far. Formal definitions of fairness and abuse-freeness are presented in the strand space model, and formal analysis shows that fairness and abuse-freeness are satisfied in the protocol.

articleTitle: Collabrative Education UI in Augmented Reality from Remote to Local
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: The goal of this paper is to provide a easy way for manipulating 3D graphical object in remote education system. We describe a remote collaborative framework running in an augmented reality environment. It provides a nature operation interface for manipulating graphics object in the web browser or applications from different locations. A Jabber like protocol is designed to translate geometry information and transformation status which reduce the total amount of data transmission. We will discuss the structure of this method, and demonstrate its usability with practical applications.

articleTitle: The Efficiency Evaluation of the College Which Based on DEA
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: On the basis of introduce the DEA method and twelve colleges of a certain university as research target, the paper select the number of teacher and stuff, the total number of teaching equipment, the number of students and academic papers, then respectively as input indicators and output indicators. The use of the C<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>R of DEA and the BCC model will conduct comprehensive analysis and evaluation for its operating efficiency and put forward a number of improvement recommendations against the departments which have lower operating efficiency.

articleTitle: Monitor and Control System Design of Grain Depot Temperature Based on Wireless Communication Technology
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: According to disadvantages of wired transmission system in grain depot temperature test equipment, we design a distributed grain depot temperature monitor and control system based on wireless communication technology and single chip microprocessor technology, etc. Field slave computer realizes each grain depot condition temperature signal collection through 1-wire bus digital temperature sensor DS18B20. Single chip microprocessor MSP430F149 processes monitor signal and drives temperature control equipment to realize constant temperature control. Based on wireless transceiver chip nRF905, system can complete collection signal wireless communicate from grain depot monitor equipment to central computer, and central computer controller connects with upper PC by serial interface RS-232, which the distributed grain depot monitor and control system is carried out. This paper mainly introduces systempsilas structure, hardware and software design in detail.

articleTitle: On Teaching Method and Evaluation Mechanism in Research Teaching
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: To meet the requirements of society development and train creative and comprehensive persons with ability and qualification, various ways and methods are sought to improve teaching quality and teaching effect. Currently, research teaching has already become one of hotspots and effective solutions among them. With focus on realizing research teaching, the paper presents its realization and adjustment methods based on feedback information during class and after class, and various learning resources, methods and platforms. Furthermore, the mechanism to evaluate teaching quality and teaching effect of research teaching is presented.

articleTitle: Handwritten Chinese Character Fuzzy Recognition Based on Pixel Distribution Probability with Segmentation Mode of Concentric Circle
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: This paper proposed a new method of handwritten Chinese character recognition. The character image is segmented into 10 sections by 10 equal-interval concentric circles. 4 segmentation modes can be formed with the combination of 10 different-radius circles. The pixel distribution probability of strokes of character in every section is calculated. The concentric circles segmentation is an ideal method since it is adaptive for the shift, zoom, incline and rotation of image. The annulus segmentation represents the minutely structural feature of character. The circle segmentation is fit for various handwritten Chinese characters. As double-optimized evaluation, the minimal distance product and the maximal fuzzy correlation measure based on the distance and the correlation coefficient of pixel distribution probability between recognized character and standard character can obviously increase the rate of character recognition.

articleTitle: Granular Computing Applied to Data-Mining of Tunnel Information
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Granular Computing(GrC) is a new concept and novel approach to solve the complex problems and provide a method for massive data-mining in the field of artificial intelligence. This paper presents a novel method which combines the quotient space theory to the granular computing for analysis of the data warehouse and data mining .This method can manage city traffic information system effectively, so it is very meaningful to the city tunnel traffic information data processing .

articleTitle: NEX: Virtual Machine Monitor Level Single System Support in Xen
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Numerous approaches have been investigated to achieve single system image in order to simplify the complexity of programming and administration of cluster. This paper focuses on virtualization approach and presents NEX, a system of cooperative hypervisors with single system image support. NEX could provide a virtual SMP machine over cluster nodes. Commodity operating systems that support SMP could run across nodes through NEX in parallel. The approach is based on prior research on virtualization and distributed shared memory. This paper describes the design and implementation of NEX and gives a preliminary evaluation.

articleTitle: Medium-Long Power Load Forecasting Based on Improved Grey BP Model
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: The power load forecasting precision being influenced by many factors, the traditional forecasting tools are not very taking the role. In fact, BP network has the characteristics of the applicable and self-learning, and grey method has the growth characteristics,this paper used the correcting coefficient to improved the grey method, so the grey BP network method can better reflect the increasing and non-linearity character than traditional grey BP method. The minimal variance method was used as the making of combination weight, through the advantages of the two methods, we can meet the high precision for the forecasting, and the whole forecasting results have greatly improved to conventional methods, above all, this method can be better using in medium and long term power load forecasting.

articleTitle: The Design and Analysis of Information Security Teaching and Learning Platform
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Teaching and studying information security is quite a challenging task for both instructors and students. To help students to master information security theories, and facilitate teachers to organize courses, we have developed an information security teaching and learning platform (referred to as SYSU-ISTLP), having been in use since 2008 at the Sun Yat-Sen University. In this paper, current situation on information security teaching are analyzed and then we provide details about the development of our SYSU-ISTLP.

articleTitle: The Research of Cross-Layer Architecture Design for MCM-Based Cognitive Radio Network
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: In this paper, we discuss the framework of MCM-Based cognitive radio network (MCM-Based CRN) and motivations for cross-layer design in CRN first. Moreover, we proposed a novel architecture in which the dynamic channel allocation is achieved by a cross-layer design between the PHY and MAC layers for MCM-Based cognitive radio network. Finally, A OFDM-Based cognitive radio transmitter and receiver is proposed.

articleTitle: The Fault Diagnosis Method for Electrical Equipment Using Bayesian Network
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Bayesian network offers a powerful map framework that can process probabilities inference. It can be used in inference and express of uncertainty knowledge. This paper introduce a new electrical equipment fault diagnosis method based on Bayesian network (BN). For example, power transformer is very important in power system as a electrical equipment. But, itpsilas very difficult to exact diagnosis the fault because power transformerpsilas complexity configuration. Now, dissolved gas analysis (DGA) is the most effective and convenient method in transformer fault diagnosis. However, the codes of DGA is too absolute, so this paper advances a new trans-former fault diagnosis method based on Bayesian network (BN). This method introduces BN method into transformer fault diagnosis and presents a new idea of finding out transformer faults rapidly and exactly. Finally, the application examples in the fault diagnosis of transformer are given which shows that this method is effective.

articleTitle: Using the Multimedia Courseware and Network Information Technology to Optimize the Geography Classroom Instruction
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: It has been pointed out by the New Curriculum that geography courses based on modern information technology should be constructed and information resources and technology measures must be used positively to optimize and enrich the geography instruction. It is not only an innovation of teaching methods to bring the multimedia and network into the field of geography instruction, but also radical influence on the ideas and notions of geography instruction for geography teachers. Appropriate use of modern information technology is the needs of modern geography instruction, the quality of education, and also of the qualified geographic personnel in the twenty-first century. Multimedia geography courseware and network information technology optimized the geography classroom instruction, which will help to enrich the teaching content and expand the geographic knowledge. By use of modern information technology to reform the traditional teaching methods, scientific concept of education and advanced teaching methods will come into the geography classroom which becomes an inevitable trend of geography reform of teaching or education.

articleTitle: Web Service Composition Based on the Annotated Ontology
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: This paper has proposed a method which implements the web service dynamic composition based on an annotated ontology. The capability parameters of the registered web services are used to annotate the domain ontology, when a request comes, only the related web service according to the annotated ontology will be matched or be composed. With the method, the efficiency can be improved significantly when a large number of web services exist.

articleTitle: The Use of Data Mining in Contents of the Examination and the Relevance of Teaching Research
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: In this paper, we use a random draw of the data of the part of subjective questions take out from students's papers in a Certificate of Education Examination in a province. We use a priori algorithm to take a processing operation on these data, excavating the questions related to the questions which more than 70% of the students fail to passed, In order to analyze the degree of the interaction between the teaching content which these subjective questions related to, and made reference to the corresponding recommendations.

articleTitle: An Interactive and Expansible Virtual Laboratory Environment for Hardware Chips Application Experiment
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: With the swift development of hardware simulation technology, virtual laboratory environment has appealed more and more attention of educators. In this paper, we develop an interactive virtual laboratory environment for hardware chips application experiment. It provides the students with real expression, convenient operation and powerful simulation capability. Furthermore, interactivity and expansibility make this system distinctive under different circumstances. Till now, our virtual laboratory environment has been implemented and successfully applied in a Computer Interface Technology course in Shanghai University and has gained positive appraisal from teachers and students.

articleTitle: The Research on Network Teaching Evaluation Based on Fuzzy Synthesis
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: The construction and improvement of teaching evaluation system is a very important part of teaching work in recent years. Along with the constant development of network-based study, a comprehensively scientifically and objective evaluation is increasingly important. To establish an evaluation system of network teaching is the needs of scientific management of teaching quality. Moreover, the study on the comprehensive evaluation of fuzzy mathematics is a new developing field in recent years, which aims at evaluating the appraisal object objectively, fairly, reasonably. Therefore, fuzzy comprehensive evaluation in network teaching is of great significance. By using different evaluated methods, the paper tries to find out a network teaching evaluation model which is based on fuzzy comprehensive evaluation, aiming at evaluating the network teaching fairly and reasonably.

articleTitle: Modeling Aspect-Oriented Programming with UML Profile
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Aspect-Oriented Programming (AOP), which allows for modularizing concerns that normally cause crosscutting in object oriented (OO) systems, has effectively solved the problem that the Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) has encountered such as the scattered codes and tangled codes resulting from the cross-cutting concerns. At present, the AOP paradigm has expanded to all the lifecycle of the software development, as a result, Aspect-Oriented Software Development (AOSD) is becoming a new technique, which has an important step of modeling the aspects. Modeling aspects is a hot topic these days, however, there is no uniform modeling technique to support this new method. Since the Unified Modeling Language (UML) is an extensible modeling language to facilitate domain specific modeling. At this paper, we use the extension mechanisms provided by the UML to model the aspects of a system to improve the stations of AOP in the software development.

articleTitle: Texture Analysis of MRI in Patients with Multiple Sclerosis Based on the Gray-Level Difference Statistics
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Objective: To investigate the differences of texture features among macroscopic lesion white matter (LWM), normal appearing white matter (NAWM) in magnetic resonance images (MRI) from patients with multiple sclerosis (MS) and normal white matter (NWM) from normal controls by gray-level difference statistics, and to detect the hidden abnormality of NAWM. Methods: T2-weighted MRI of 26 MS patients and 26 healthy subjects were selected, and 26 regions of interests (ROI) were chosen from MS patient MRI and healthy subject MRI for LWM, NAWM and NWM respectively. All of the ROI were analyzed by gray-level difference statistics, and contrast, angular second moment, mean and entropy those four texture features were extracted. Finally statistic significance was tested among three groups. Results: In LWM, NAWM and NWM groups, the increasing tendency was shown for angular second moment (0.1108, 0.2173 and 0.2649) , while decreasing tendency for contrast (41.5534, 9.4723 and 4.7341) mean(0.0184, 0.0086 and 0.0064) and entropy (1.0745, 0.7715 and 0.6648). Except contrast that the difference was not significant (P=0.26) between NAWM and NWM , the rests had significant differences (P<0.05) between LWM and NAWM (or NWM) or NAWM and NWM. Conclusion: Texture analysis can possible reveal the microscopic abnormality in patients with MS,and will be beneficial to the research of early diagnosis and treatment estimate of MS.

articleTitle: Research on Design of Computer Fundamental Teaching Material Based on SDL
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Higher education computer fundamental course reform faced the 21st century has already been started in an all-round way. Innovation of teaching material's design philosophy is one of important contents that can't be ignored.The design and writing philosophy of university computer fundamental teaching material is summarized and reviewed leaded by the theory of self-directory learning, and an example page is shown.

articleTitle: A Research of Fuzzy AHP Approach in Evaluating Distance Education System  Alternatives
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: The paper proposes a structured model for evaluating distance education system alternatives using the fuzzy analytical hierarchy process (FAHP). Selecting process of an alternative has been very important issue for education centers for years. The paper aims to demonstrate how FAHP model can help in solving such decisions in practice. The effectiveness of the FAHP model is illustrated using a company in China and the results validated using fuzzy AHP. It also describes the related research of FAHP.

articleTitle: A Case Study on Relationship between Mortgage Payment and Income Using Quantile Regression
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Compared to ordinary linear regression, quantile regression not only reveals more regional information, but also makes parameter estimates more robust. This study analyzes the relationship between mortgage payment and household income for both Chinese households and American households using a linear quantile regression model with one independent variable.

articleTitle: A New Temporal Error Concealment Algorithm for H.264 Using Motion Strength of Neighboring Area
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Transmission of compressed video over error prone channels may result in packet losses or errors, which can significantly degrade the image quality. Error concealment is an effective approach to reduce the influence. In this paper, a new temporal error concealment algorithm for the H.264 is presented, which efficiently utilize the motion vectors of top/bottom macro blocks adjacent to the lost macro block. Firstly, the motion strength of neighboring area (MSNA) is estimated by calculating a ratio involving the motion vectors of adjacent macro blocks. Then the motion vector recovery algorithm using either minimum variance of boundary motion vectors method or polynomial interpolation method is employed according to the magnitude of MSNA. Experimental results show that the proposed algorithm improves the subjective video quality and obtains a gain of about 0.2dB~2.5dB in PSNR, compared with conventional temporal error concealment algorithms in the condition of equal packet loss rate.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Collaborative Knowledge Building Model Based on Web2.0
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Collaborative Knowledge Building (CKB) is a process involved in groups of participant to collect knowledge, communicate knowledge, share knowledge, and create knowledge together. While Web2.0 is characterized by being user-centered, two-ways communication and creating knowledge together in social network formation, thus Web2.0 concepts seems to be an ideal fit with CKB. However, how to integrate the undoubted significant factors into the CKB process is a question in Web2.0 era. According to analyzing the outline of CKB and characters of Web2.0, this paper integrates Web2.0 into CKB, and presents a new CKB model. Finally, the paper takes application example of Personal Knowledge Building platform and Collaborative Knowledge Building platform to show Web2.0 is beneficial to realize a more feasible CKB model, which is illustrated how to use Web2.0 tools in the CKB process.

articleTitle: Data Association Algorithm for Passive Sensor System
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: This paper mainly study angle-measurement based data association algorithm to overcome the existing problems in the applications of traditional association approaches forbearing-only target locating and tracking system. By deeply analyzing different data association algorithms and target motion characteristics in bearing-only coordinate, suitable angle-measurement based association algorithm is presented.As the results, the two-dimensional bearing-only measurement confirming efficiency of real target is improved and false tracking with the dense clutter is limited. The application of this algorithm has effectively resolved the track association problem of the bearing-only tracking using a single passive sensor. The application of the proposed approach in a simulation system proves its effectiveness and practicability.

articleTitle: Investigation of the Measure and Control Method for Vibration of the Variable-Frequency Precisely Cropping Machine
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: An effective measure and control method is necessary in the cropping machine which utilizes the variable-frequency vibration to shear bar with low stress. Based on the analysis of the principle of the cropping machine, the hardware of the measurement and control system is built up. A piezoelectric sensor and charge amplifier are employed to collect the vibration characteristic of the cropping machine through a PCL 818L data card. The software of measurement and control for vibration is programmed based on the LabVIEW, whose main interface is friendly and practical. According to the perfect results of the cropping experiments, the presented measure and control method for the cropping machine is effective. A good foundation for further investigation on the principle of the cropping machine is established.

articleTitle: The Reform and Practice on the Course of Principle and Interfaces Technology of Microcomputer
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: The paper introduces the gradualness of progressive teaching on microcomputer and interfacing technology, and also intends to explore the classroom teaching, experimental teaching and management practice in the class.

articleTitle: Study of Embedded Operating System Memory Management
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: This paper studies the basic requirements of embedded operating system memory management and the key problems in memory management, via analyze the advantages and disadvantages of different memory management algorithm, according to the features of the embedded system such as the mount of the memory is few, and has no MMU, and has real-time requirements usually, Then proposed a method that can distribute and recycle the memory swiftly, and the operation time to the memory is certain, so Itpsilas able to meet the needs of embedded operating systempsilas real-time performance requirements effectively, moreover use this approach to manage memory can avoid excessive memory fragments.

articleTitle: An Analysis on the Chaos Behavior of Currency Exchange Rate Undulation
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: The dynamical theory of chaos is the new analysis method of study on the exchange rate undulation in the foreign exchange market. In order to study the chaos behavior of the Euro exchange rate, this paper put the purchase price of the RMB to the Euro as the sample and analyzes the nonlinear character of the Euro exchange rate. This paper figures out the Hurst exponent by the R/S analysis and confirms the chaos behavior of the Euro exchange rate accordingly, and then the paper tests the nonlinear character of the Euro exchange rate by the GARCH Model at finally.

articleTitle: Building up Problem-Based Learning Platform Based on J2EE
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Problem-Based Learning is a way which centres on students' self-educated learning and questionspsila researching. With the development of the network technology, the learning pattern of the network Problem-Based Learning becomes more and more popular. To build a series of network learning platform of education technology which have powerful function, has put forward some new requirements. The article explained the basic process about building a problem-based learning platform which based on JSP and Javabean technology according to J2EE.

articleTitle: Application of Virtual Reality Technology in the Field of Sport
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: The virtual reality technology (VRT) is a multi-disciplinary comprehensive technology, which appears following the computer technology, computer graphics, computer network technology, image processing and pattern recognition, intelligent connection technology, multi-sensor technologies, pronunciation processing and acoustic technologypsilas fast developments and so on. In recent years, VRT has been used widely in the field of sport such as diving, gymnastics, trampoline, basketball and skiing, especially at diving and trampoline. The virtual reality technology, virtual reality modeling language theories, especially the application of the virtual reality technology, and the three-dimensional visualization emulation technique in field of sport were discussed.

articleTitle: Design of Smart Nodes for RFID Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs) and Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) are the two most important technologies in pervasive computing. Because of their different applications, researchers tend to research them respectively. This paper presents a new architecture for the integration of these two technologies, which is called RFID Wireless Sensor Networks, and gives the design of hardware circuit and software structure of smart nodes. Finally, we realizes the function of monitoring environment on the basis of a low-power microprocessor MSP430F5437, a RF transceiver CC2420, a RFID reader CC2500, and temperature, humidity, light intensity and pressure sensors.

articleTitle: Design of the Optimal Path Algorithm for Line Track Robots
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: According to the path information collected,combined with the characteristics of the car body, the data of the path has been analyzed, the path optimizing algorithm for line track robots has been established, and the correctness of the algorithm has been verified in experiments in this paper. The algorithm design has some certain significance for the line track optimization of robots and the autopilot of vehicles.

articleTitle: A Fast Intra Prediction Algorithm for H.264
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Transporting hybrid coded video over wireless channel is very challenging. Efficient coding and compression techniques are required to meet the QoS (Quality of Service) requirements of such services. H.264, the latest coding and compression standard from ITU-T, is currently dominating the field by offering a flexible architecture and compression gain of up to 50%. In H.264, intra frame prediction is conducted in the spatial domain. There are two types of intra prediction for luma-Intra_16times16 and Intra_4times4. Four and nine modes are supported respectively. The complexity and computation load increase drastically. A fast mode decision algorithm for H.264 intra prediction is presented in this paper. The algorithm predicts every macroblock using macroblock features before coding, then selects parts of the prediction modes. Experimental results show that the proposed fast algorithm can achieve 30% to 60% computation reduction while maintaining similar PSNR and bit rate performance of H.264 encoder.

articleTitle: Optimal Frequency-Hopping Sequences Based on Cyclotomy
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Frequency-hopping sequences (FHSs) are used to specify which frequency will be used for transmission at any given time, their properties play important roles in FHMA systems. In this correspondence, new families of FHSs are constructed by using Chinese reminder theorem and C.Ding etal.psilas results. The constructed FHSs family is proved to be optimal and each sequence of the family is proved to be near optimal.

articleTitle: A New Approach to Improve CD Based on the Context
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: In this paper, I develop a new approach to improve the Contradiction Detection (CD) incorporating the additional information from the context, which aimed at improving the CD precision. My work focuses on using additional context from the sentences or pages to disambiguate the event/entity. I give a new method but the probability to do the ambiguity examination. Whatpsilas more, I develop a CD system which inspired by AUCONTRAIRE CD system and give the concrete steps to achieve the goal.

articleTitle: The Comparative Research of the Ambiguity of Comprehension of Human-Machine Language
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: This paper discusses the characteristics of ambiguity emerging when understanding natural language, describes the traditional methods of natural language syntactic analysis, and at last, through examples about digestion language ambiguity, makes a deeper cognition and comprehension comparison of human-computer language grammar ambiguity by using the syntactic analysis method which combining rules and statistics.

articleTitle: The Echo Model of Telecommunication Market Agents Based on Complex Environment
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: This paper intends to establish the interactive communication networks intensity of its information resources in the small world, applying ant colony algorithm and eventually to design information resources interactive mechanism, which based on the echo model of the TMA (TELECOMMUNICATION MARKET AGENT). The information resource communication and transmission of TMA is to promote the information resourcepsilas emergency, self-organization and fractal at a high overall level. This paper is intent to model from the complex systems of integral telecommunications perspective and analysis of the evolution process. The adaptability is TMA's imperative aggregation condition .The TMAs donpsilat only keep the information resource in the original position during the interactive activity but also cause mutual decision influence, evolution and currency of information resource. The aim of controlling the TMA information spread and interaction is to make the invisible advantageous and virtual information be dominant and make the dominant inferior and weak information invisible.

articleTitle: An Intelligence Tutoring System Based on Knowledge Grid
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: In teaching practice, it is hard to accurately, systematically evaluating how well students master the knowledge.The reason that students can not understand the current concept is that prerequisite knowledge hasn't been grasped, and students also do not know the potential impact on the following course. It is difficult to implement trace and personalized analysis. The intelligence tutoring system based on the "knowledge grid"(ITSKG) makes use of "knowledge grid" to set up a shared, collaborative knowledge system based on web, guides students to understand the problem systematically. It can implement “knowledge ramble” originating from one node in "knowledge grid" as a starting point. Then, it will form the “missing knowledge chain” which shows the student’s present knowledge architecture. Finally, the results will be sent to different virtual organizations which are constituted by teachers, so that their Q&A will become more effective.

articleTitle: Promoting Embedded Education by Student Technology Club
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Embedded system education is an enormous challenge for the universities because embedded system is at the intersection of different disciplines and in continuous rapid progress. Outstanding curriculum design of embedded system will keep students close to the requirements from industry. In this paper, we share our experiences in how to promote embedded system education by student technology club. This club is under the construction and management by the students themselves. It helps the students to study embedded system consciously and actively.

articleTitle: An Efficient Data Streams Mining Method for Wireless Sensor Network's Data Aggregation
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Wireless distributed sensor systems will enable the reliable monitoring of a variety of environments for both civil and military applications. The data model generated by sensor network is data streams. Because of the rapid data arriving speed and huge size of data set in stream model, novel one-pass algorithms are devised to support data aggregation on demand. In this paper, we focus on data aggregation, which can have significant impact on sensor network. VFDT is one of the most successful algorithms for data streams mining, which uses Hoeffding inequality to achieve a probabilistic bound on the accuracy of the tree constructed; we revisit this problem and propose an efficient algorithm for handling wireless sensor networkpsilas streaming data. In order to examine this algorithm, we study its performance with different data noise level, number of sensor network nodes and number of data. Overall, the techniques introduced here can handle wireless sensor networkpsilas data efficiently.

articleTitle: The Visual Simulator for Assembly Language Programming
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Students learning computer organization and assembly language programming often have difficulty understanding the relationship between hardware functions and software instructions. Some experimental instruments are used in teaching. According to the problems in traditional experimental teaching, based on the analysis and animation, a software tool has been realized. It provides a visually simulation of the execution of machine and assembly language programs on a simple computer. It can run without specifically equipment, and it is suitable for in-class demonstrations and various types of in-class or out of class assignments.

articleTitle: Emphasis on the Computational Quantitative Research on Mass Motivation of Students' Evaluation of Teaching
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: As a major part of teaching performance management in universities, Students' Evaluation of Teaching (SEOT) is of great significance in strengthening education management. However, this evaluation mechanism is going through three development troubles. First, the doubt from the traditional culture. Second, it can not efficiently promote teaching quality. Third, the theoretical dilemma of SEOT. Currently, the deficiency of SEOT mainly reflects in terms that the present performance management system does not take college students' motivation of evaluation into consideration, and that the theoretical research lacks the research on motivation, while the motivation of evaluation directly impacts the credibility and effectiveness of the evaluation results. The development of research on computer quantification technology related to the motivation of SEOT can protect and encourage strict teachers, lead the students to evaluate their teachers with serious and subjective attitude, improve teaching quality effectively, and build up world-class universities with a rigor study atmosphere.

articleTitle: Video Quality Assessment Based on Spatial-Temporal Distortion
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Objective quality assessment plays a very important role in the video applications, as they promise the means to evaluate the performance of acquisition, display, coding and communication systems. Objective video quality assessment still has a long way to go before it reaches the level of success. In this paper, we propose novel quality metrics for video sequences. This metrics are capable of capturing spatial distortions in video sequences, in addition to temporal artifacts. And they can quantify the spatial distortions and differentiate the type of distortion. Furthermore the metrics correlate well with the subjective quality measures because perception distortions of human have been taken into consideration. Experimental results show that our perceptual quality metrics performs better than the existing methods.

articleTitle: Matlab Simulation in Signals & Systems Using Matlab at Different Levels
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: This paper describes the simulation by Matlab in the course of signals and systems. Matlabpsilas rich and powerful functions provide various methods to analyze the signals and systems, including both continuous and discrete situations. Some methods can simplify the complicated calculation; some finish the same functions in accordance with the mathematical processing; and some can save operation time via efficient algorithms. That is to say, Matlab can be used at different levels to help students solve problems quickly and efficiently, or help them understand the signal processing procedures deeply and in detail, even apply their knowledge on data structure to develop some new algorithms. Matlab helps to make the boring theoretical study less abstract and more vivid and has become an important auxiliary teaching method being used widely.

articleTitle: A Method for Classification of English Reading Materials Based on Web Information Mining
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: With the continuous improvement of information technology and increasing numbers of Web resources, the mode of English reading teaching has changed fundamentally, and the diversity and flexibility of English reading materials achieve a great progress. Because English reading materials were hand-election selection, subjects were lack of varieties and the classification work was heavy, this paper provides a model for automation classification of English reading materials based on Web information mining. Through this method, it will provide an effective method for building a highly efficient and practical system of automatic classification of English reading materials.

articleTitle: Taking Flexible and Diverse Approaches to Get Undergraduate Students Interested in Cryptography Course
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: With the extensive application of cryptography technologies in our lives, cryptography course has been paid more attention to in many universities. The contents of cryptography course are profound and complicated, so it becomes quite hard for some undergraduate students with less mathematical background. In addition to, the class hours have not enough and experimental condition is very poor in some universities. Many students usually have negative feelings in learning. How could we get them interested in cryptography course? This paper proposes teaching methods should be flexibility and diversity, and they cover a lot of ground such as telling stories on breaking ciphers, using interactive education software to demonstrate cryptography algorithm, reinforcing students’ mathematic concept, gaining more practical experience in our lives, exploring and discussing on a particular subject. After having taken these approaches to teach students cryptography course, we finally have eliminated students’ negative feelings of be afraid of difficulties and have aroused their enthusiasm in learning.

articleTitle: An Approach to Performance Evaluation of Software Architecture
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Software architecture is the bridge from requirement to realization, to determine software quality. Based on analyze the description of software architecture ,this paper derives a performance evaluation models, based on UML collaboration and sequence diagram. Extend Queueing Network Models on route and arrived rate. Finally, use the example of client/server architecture, to prove the approach correctly.

articleTitle: Designing a Team Teaching Program for Language Teaching and Learning: A Case Study
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: This paper discusses how to design a team teaching program for language teaching and learning for an undergraduate intensive reading course. The purpose of this study is to investigate how team teaching is applied and how it influences faculty and students. Team teaching plan, methodology, and pilot study were discussed in order to suggest the concrete steps to team teaching in this kind of course and transfer our understandings and success to other courses, such as senior teachers cooperate with junior teachers, foreign teachers cooperate with domestic teachers.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Peephole Optimization Based on Extensible Template
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Optimization functions are crucial to compiler design. Generally, compiler optimization divides into machine-independent optimization based on the intermediate language and machine-dependent optimization based on the object code. In order to make use of the characteristics of the target machine, this paper presents an optimization scheme about peephole optimization based on extensible template, and introduces the implementation of this scheme for a C compiler of 16-bit embedded CPU system.

articleTitle: Analysis of New Teaching Model for Undergraduates in University Based on the Environment of Information Technology - A Case for Specialty of Information Management & Information System
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: This paper is mainly about analyzing and exploring the new teaching model for the specialty of information Management & Information System. The purpose of it is to discuss how to set up a good interactive platform of teaching and learning for undergraduate. Firstly, advantage and disadvantage of the traditional teaching model are analyzed in this paper, and characters of teaching and learning in the new times are summarized. And then, this paper proposes and explains three new teaching models in detail. Thirdly, based on analysis of the ability system for the specialty of information Management & Information System, this paper tries to design the new teaching models and construct a framework for platform of teaching for undergraduate based on networks. Finally, a design concept of the platform is discussed detailedly.

articleTitle: PMonitor: A Lightweight Performance Monitor for Virtual Machines
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Performance monitor for virtual machines can monitor the performance metrics of virtual machines and gain the resource consumption status, and thus provide reliable basis for system performance evaluation and further management. However, at current stage, such performance monitor systems for the virtualized systems are inadequate and inefficient. In this paper, we propose a lightweight performance monitor system model for virtual machines, called PMonitor. Through prototype implementation and experiments, we find that PMonitor consumes very few processing power, which is much lower than other open source performance monitors running on the virtualized environments.

articleTitle: Research on Distribution Centers Location Problem under E-Commerce Environment Based on Max-Min Ant System
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: The distribution center (DC) plays an important role as a bridge in maintaining the uninterrupted flow of goods between the suppliers and customers, and its location problem is attached importance very much. As electronic commerce is developing rapidly, it brings new distribution demand for logistics; in particular customers require more satisfying service of time. In this paper, the existing distribution center location model is expanded by adding time cost and considering the situation with multi-suppliers and multi-customers, so we construct the DCs location model under e-commerce. Meanwhile, this problem is divided into the supply stage and the distribution stage, and then we use the max-min ant clustering algorithm at these stages respectively to optimize the complete location problem. A numerical example is given to validate the feasibility of this algorithm, and the results indicate that this algorithm is suitable for the DC location with the existence of multi-suppliers and multi-customers.

articleTitle: Based on the Gray System Theory Analysis to Analysis Graduate Education Quality
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: This paper proposes an evaluation system of graduate education quality by using gray system theory, the use of models to assess the basic steps, based on AHP's assessment of the gray model, the final assessment of the overall design of the system.

articleTitle: The Design and Realization of the Urban Rail Transit ATC Simulation for Teaching System
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: This article provides a whole design project of ATC simulating and teaching system, and presents the framework, the function and the module of ATC simulating software. Finally we will give you a solution of system. Shanghai Metro Line 3 is the prototype of this simulating teaching system, which is the base of multimedia and network teaching to achieve the platform of ATC teaching. The teaching and application of system is to aim at training the people who specialize in rail transportation and the metro staff in the field of ATC. This system has taken good effect in the teaching at the present time.

articleTitle: Practice and Exploration in Multimedia Technology Education
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Multimedia has become ubiquitous in nowadays world along with the rapid development of information technology. Yet the courses in todaypsilas colleges could not reflect this trend. In this paper we analyze the issues in todaypsilas multimedia education, and discuss the concepts behind the design of the multimedia course of Beihang University for undergraduate students, as well as its status of practice.

articleTitle: Flight Delay Alarming Analysis for an Airport Based on Markov
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Flight delay is the most prominent problem in the field of an airport to circulate to manage in recent years. In order to make a comparative accurate forecast of the flight delay situation, this paper gives an improved Markov model by adding the system with a weight adjustment. By using the optimization method, we compute state transition probability matrix, analyze the data from the capital airport, and forecast the probability of the departure flights in all the delaying time section. The probability of flight delay is divided into five levels. For each level we make a forecast with one day data chosen from the airport. The warning method for airport flight delay forecasting makes use of time fragmenting technique by an interval of 20 minutes. Simulation experiment gives out error analysis. And the comparison with delay probability getting from the practical data indicates that the forecast effect is ideal. It has good application value in the practical application.

articleTitle: Study on the Origin and Constitution of the Risks in Every Stage of Chinese Enterprises Overseas M&As
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Chinese enterprises overseas M&As is a complicated systematic project involving large risks. Therefore, it is important to correctly identify the M&A risks. Only by this can effective risk preventive measures be formulated. There are three stages in Chinese enterprises overseas M&As, i.e. the early stage of M&As, the middle stage of M&As and the late stage of M&As, all of which have different problems and risks.

articleTitle: The Research and Application of Education Innovation and Innovation Talent Cultivation
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Innovation education and cultivating innovative talents is not only the tactic demand of the higher education in the new period but also the important duty of our society. It's a complicated course of the cultivation of innovative talents. It needs various aspects' corresponding development and osculation cooperation. According to analyse the intension of the quality education, the factors, the aims and the problems of the higher school's education innovation currently, seeks the way and method of innovative education and innovative talents cultivation to make the higher school's talents fit the need of the knowledge economy ages

articleTitle: The Simulation Study on Temperature Control System of Nitriding Electric-Furnace Based on Fuzzy-PID Control
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: In order to optimize the technology of parts which have complex shape and are easy to be deformed in gas nitriding, an improvement is applied to the temperature-control system of a gas nitriding electric-furnace which exists much lag in temperature, by adopting a Fuzzy-PID controller, and then the Fuzzy-PID controller is designed, furthermore, the simulation experiments are made based on the tool of MATLAB7.0. The results of simulation indicate that the temperature-control effect of Fuzzy-PID controller is better than that of the conventional PID controller. Moreover, this result of research on simulation has an active guidance to the optimization of heating process for technology of gas nitriding.

articleTitle: An Alogrithm for Indirect Schema Mapping Composition
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: There are a large number of indirect schema mappings between peers in the network. To improve the efficiency of data exchange and queries, indirect mappings are needed to be composed. Defined the combination operations of schema elements in indirect mappings, and gave the expression of indirect mappings. Proposed a strategy, named schema element back, to solve the problem of indirect mapping composition, and gave the indirect mapping composition generation algorithm based on such strategy. Experiments showed that indirect mapping composition can improve the efficiency of data exchange, and compared with other non-full mapping composition generation algorithms, and indirect mapping composition generated by our algorithm based on schema element back strategy can completely eliminate the infection of media schema with no reduction of the composition efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on College English Teaching Mold Promoting Students' Individual Self-Learning
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: The teaching reform based on the technology of computer and the Internet has been carried out for years in NCEPU. We have been searching for better a teaching mold combining class teaching with studentspsila online self-autonomous learning, which both overcome the weaknesses and inherits the advantages in traditional teaching. After the teaching reform, we compare the studentspsila performances in experimental classes and in traditional classes, and find that students in experimental classes are better than those in traditional classes, which confirms that the new teaching mode can better promote studentspsila self-learning ability and practical English capacity. Thus this new teaching mode is proved to be superior to the traditional one and is worthy of further research and extension.

articleTitle: Application of NIR Spectroscopy in Classification of Plant Species
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Near-infrared spectroscopy (NIRS) analysis is a rapidly-developing non-destructive technology with increasingly wide range of applications, but application of NIRS technology in the classification of plants is still rare. Based on experimental study, this paper uses the approach of principal component analysis (PCA) combined with the establishment of a Mahalanobis distance of plantspsila leaves to establish the discrimination model of leaves, and adopts multiplicative scatter correction (MSC) and a first-order differential to analyze the model. The analysis results are quite consistent with experimental data, and obtained a satisfactory classification rate of 100%, which shows that this approach can be used to classify plant species, and it can become a very useful tool in many relevant fields.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Object Recognition Based on Fuzzy Relative Entropy
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Based on fuzzy similarity degree, relative entropy and fuzzy entropy, novel fuzzy relative entropy is presented. The novel fuzzy relative entropy has a full physical meaning and succinct practicability and it can be used as a measurement to measure the difference between fuzzy patterns. The example demonstrates that the novel relative entropy is valid and reliable for fuzzy pattern recognition and classification.

articleTitle: A Dualistic and Dynamic Student Model Based on “Fuzzy Cluster”
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: The thesis aims to illustrate the way how to construct a dualistic and dynamic Student Model in SQLTutor intelligent teaching system. The initial level of the Student Model is to collect the data of the student performance, and paradigmatically record and sort out the performance data of the individual student. The senior level of the Student Model is to apply the ldquofuzzy clusterrdquo method to analyze further the data drawn from the initial level so that we can syntagmatically evaluate the overall students. Practice has proved that the Student Model can deliver a qualitative and quantitative evaluation of the individualized online learning of the students.

articleTitle: Method of Accurate Design of a Microwave Band-Pass Filter Based on Adjust of Center Frequency
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: In this paper, the problem of excursion in center frequency of half-wavelength parallel-coupled line band-pass filter in traditional design is discussed.First of all, the basic principle of half-wavelength parallel-coupled-resonator filter is introduced, and the reasons for the deviation of center frequency are analyzed. Based on an approximately linear correction in center frequency,a parallel coupling band-pass filter with high performance working in X wave band is designed . The simulation results in ADS (advanced design system) approves the validity of this theory , in compare, the relative error between the theory and the optimal goal is less than 10%.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Curriculum Independency Network Courseware
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Development and promotion difficulty about network courseware is analyzed, and one kind of curriculum independency network courseware is proposed, Mainly introduced the design mentality and the key technologies when realization. The system may found the network courseware on different curriculum conveniently, and implements the dynamic content management.

articleTitle: Research of Campus Grid Management Information System
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Campus grid management information system is the important part of digital campus infomationization construction. This article introduced the grid management thought and specific gird division methods, proposed the architecture of the campus grid management information system based on the grid management.

articleTitle: Mapping Approach for Model Transformation of MDA Based on XMI/XML Platform
