publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Model driven architecture (MDA), which takes platform independent modeling and platform specific transforming as its core technologies, is a software development method and standards system using modeling newly issued by OMG. It analyzes the basic theorem of ROSE, and point out deficiency the model transformation from PIM to PSM. This paper presents a vision of mapping method from PIM to PSM based on XMI/XML platform, using UML. UML profile and MOF makes up PIM and designs theorem of transformation through XMI.

articleTitle: The Design and Implement of Web MIS of Students Based on Servlet+JDBC
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: This paper, focusing on how to integrate programming language and database, discusses the way to development Web application by Servlet and JDBC, and gives an example of designing and implementing of a Web MIS is presented, which provides a reference to design of other systems alike.

articleTitle: The Levels and Realization of E-learning Platforms
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Today is an age when information and technology accumulates and spreads rapidly. On one hand, the explosion of information and technology subjects people to the effort of amassing a large pool of knowledge; on the other hand, the updating of information and technology is accelerating. Thus, it is necessary to change the present ways to promote effective learning. Under this background, e-learning developed with the popularity of Internet. There are increasing demands among organizations for e-learning, and the construction and the selection of e-learning platforms have gained more and more attention. As the levels of e-learning platforms are important guarantees of effective e-learning, this paper introduces four kinds of authoritative divisions of levels of e-leaning platforms and the ways to realize them. Moreover, it compares the characteristics of different programming languages. At last, it mentions the trends of the development of modern e-learning platforms.

articleTitle: A New Method for Blur Identification of Out-of-Focus Images
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: This paper presents a new method for blur identification of out-of-focus images, which is assumed that at least one sharp edge could be detected. The line spread function (LSF) could be derived from the edge(s) of the image and the perfect line spread functions (LSFs) are constructed from the out-of-focus model. Then least square function is used to determine the radius of defocus blur. This approach has fast speed as it works in spatial domain without complex Fourier transformation or iterative computation. The experimental results validate the accuracy and efficiency of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Framework for Designing Problem-Based Learning Environments
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: It is asserted that problem solving is the sole legal educational goal. But problem solving relies on appropriate scaffoldings to successfully implement. One approach that seems much promise of supporting it is to construct problem-based learning environments (PBLEs). PBLEs have tremendous potential for problem-based learning, but carry design challenges and concerns with them too. This paper will explore the meanings and components of the PBLEs, and a move towards the perspectives and development of framework for designing PBLEs, which followed by an illustration focus on its rich implications and essential features.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Interpolative Reasoning Method Based on Spline
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: When rule base is sparse and an observation is in the gap between two neighboring antecedences, we cannot get a satisfactory reasoning result by traditional fuzzy reasoning method. Fuzzy reasoning is really an interpolation. For only using two neighboring rules, classical KH linear interpolative reasoning method is partial and its consequence does not always preserve convexity and normality. This paper presents a non-linear fuzzy interpolative method based on B-spline. Definitions of fuzzy setpsilas core set, left core, right core, center core, left width, middle width and right width are given. The method includes two steps. First confirm the core of result fuzzy sets, and then confirm the shape of result fuzzy sets. The method can not only handle one dimension and multidimensional fuzzy reasoning but also preserve the convexity and normality of reasoning consequence. Two class simulation instances are given.

articleTitle: Mining User's Interest from Interactive Behaviors in QA System
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: User interest model, as a key component of user model, is very important for personalized or user adaptive E-learning systems. In this paper, we propose an approach for mining userpsilas interest from interactive behaviors. We also develop and implement a domain-specific interactive QA system oriented to Artificial Intelligence. The course ontology, predefined to describe the skeleton of AI course, is used to generate the structure of our interactive QA system. Students can pose and browse questions and answers on their favorite boards. The interactive behaviors, including whether student has pose a question, browsing and answering times, are considered to compute each studentpsilas interest. The experiment conducted to evaluate the performance of our approach indicates that our method can capture userpsilas interest precisely.

articleTitle: Pen Gestures Based Mathematics Editing to an ITS on Algebraic Calculation
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: We had developed an prototype of pen gestures based mathematics editing which is applied to an ITS guiding algebraic calculation. Pen gestures enable students edit expressions (such as select, erase, overwrite, move and paste) directly with a pen instead of keyboard and mouse. Mathematics editing includes symbol editing and sub expression editing. Evaluation experiment results show that students think that pen gestures provide a natural and convenient expression editing environment on their algebraic learning.

articleTitle: Image Matching Based on Local Invariant Feature and Histogram-Based Similar Distance
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: In this paper we present a novel approach combining local invariant feature descriptor ARPIH (Angular Radial Partitioning Intensity Histogram) with histogram-based similar distance (HSD). The method succeeds the descriptorpsilas distinctiveness and provides higher robustness for image deformations, such as rotation, illumination changing and perspective, etc. We present the HSD to calculate the number of the similar points between template image and target image in order to decrease the calculation complicacy and improve the matching precision. The matching results show good performance of our approach for both geometric deformations and illumination changing.

articleTitle: A New Algorithm of Pattern Recognition Based on RBF Neural Network and Monkey-King Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: A new algorithm of pattern recognition based on RBF neural network and monkey-king genetic algorithm (MK-RBFNN) is prsented. The algorithm includes two parts. The first parts is that Monkey-King genetic algorithm is introduced to determine the initial positions and number of the hidden layer centers in RBF network. The second part is to set up the RBF neural network to do pattern recognition by learning and training the input sample data. Finally, experiments are implemented on datasets as Iris and WINES, which shows that the proposed algorithm has higher recognition ability compared with the conventional methods.

articleTitle: Teaching Research and Practice of Data Structure Based on Knowledge Structure
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: On the basis of studying the status of data structure in the courses for computer science and technology specialty and its knowledge structure,teaching method based on knowledge structure is proposed to raise studentspsila motivation, to organize teaching contents reasonably, to select topic scientifically,and so forth. Some statistic data of teaching practice are shown to prove this.

articleTitle: A New Adaptiveness Model in Learning System Based on Learner Context
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Adaptive learning system must support different learning objectives and contexts of different learners. However only a very limited requirements above can be considered in present adaptive learning systems, especially in learning objectives. By extending the domain model and the user model and introducing the directed hypergragh theory in learning system, three types of adaptiveness to the user model: learning objective adaptiveness, learning navigation adaptiveness and learning content adaptiveness in learning system are defined formally, analyzed in detail, and implemented arithmetically. The research shows that three types of adaptiveness to the user model in learning system above can support the adaptiveness to different leaning objectives and styles of users effectively.

articleTitle: Building a Community-Based Collaborative Learning System Using Multi-Agent
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: The paper presents a system that using multi-agent technology to organize and reorganize supportive communities based on learners. Through effective award and exchange algorithms, learners with similar interests and experiences form a community to support each otherspsila learning.

articleTitle: Design of a Prototype for Augmented Reality Defective Bone Repair Simulation System
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Combining the exiting bone scaffold design system and augmented reality interactive technology, this paper presents an aided planning and test interactive system frame for defective bone repair surgery, and develops the prototype system based on it. The system allows the clinician to carry out the surgical planning and simulation directly using the virtual model, after designing the CAD model of defective bone scaffold. The results, which can be used to validate and modify the bone scaffold model.

articleTitle: Application of the Spectral Analysis in Ultrasonic Quantitative Testing of Bonding Defect of Composite Material
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: The quantitative testing of bonding defect at interface of composite material is a problem in ultrasonic NDT filed. At present with the wide application of this material the demand for an effective method to increase testing accuracy and stability has become more and more evident. In this paper the ultrasonic echo signals are analyzed in frequency domain and extracted the coefficients of amplitudes attenuation as feature values by using the method of the spectral analysis. Quantitative testing and evaluation have been realized. The detail description of the principle and computing method of the maximum entropy spectral estimation and characteristic values extraction are presented in the paper. The detections to the practical samples were carried out and the results show the samples with different degree of debond flaws can be identified with high accuracy.

articleTitle: Visual Simulation of Breaking Waves in Shallow Water
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: We introduce a composite method for simulation and rendering of breaking waves in computer graphics applications. The method generated not only a simple wave belt like previous work, but also a manipulative model by influence of the wind. The particle system we adopted combine POINT primitive as basic particle and fat particle as characteristics particle are well suited for simulate all kinds of spray in shallow water. Rendering makes use of Cg shading language on consumer-level GPU to allow for a representation of reflection, refraction of light.

articleTitle: Flood Simulation and Information Management System's Design and Implement
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: To address the problems in Water Resources Branchpsilas works, the paper is to design and implement an integrated information management and simulation system which combines WebGIS, database and hydrological model for them. This paper focuses on the architecture and implementation of the system, solves the developing issues based on ArcServer, and introduces a new flood simulation method to implement flood simulation by the system. It is lead a new concept to the research field of flood management and solve the current problems for Water Resources Administration.

articleTitle: Construct COW Based on MPICH in Linux Environment
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Parallel computing has been applied extensively in many areas nowadays. COW (cluster of workstations) based on MPICH in Linux OS (operating system) is a cheap and efficient approach for implementing parallel computing. In this paper, a COW based on MPICH is constructed under the environment of Linux; the detailed process for software configuration is also discussed. Finally, a matrix multiplication parallel algorithm is executed to test the COW and the test result shows that the COW works stably and normally.

articleTitle: A Study of Virtual Enterprise Modeling Based on Domain Specific Software Architecture
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Virtual enterprise model affords the valid instruction for rapid establishing and successful running of virtual enterprise. However, authors perceive that low quality and low efficiency are serious restriction factor to the development of virtual enterprise model. In order to overcome above-mentioned embarrassment in virtual enterprise modeling, authors put forward applying software reuse technology and domain engineering theory to establishing the domain specific software architecture of virtual enterprise, then develop application system and establish the reusable component library in terms of domain specific software architecture of virtual enterprise. On the one hand, the quality and efficiency of modeling can be promoted remarkably. On the other hand, the model of virtual enterprise can be reused in the same domain.

articleTitle: 3D Vehicle Location Based on Improved Hausdorff Distance and Distributed Estimation Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: 3D model is used for vision based vehicle location. An improved Hausdorff distance based on edge-strength is proposed to evaluate the similarity between 3D model projection and image feature, and to establish location optimization function In order to avoid local minimum during optimization, estimation of distribution algorithm concerning related multi-variables is used. The relationship between matching parameters are described with a probability model, and the distribution of parameter evolves towards the direction of dominant character through probability model learning and the corresponding operation, which is proposed to solve the problem of over many iteration and slow constringency velocity. The experiments show that the optimal matching parameters between 3D model and 2D image feature can be found accurately and efficiently, and the algorithm outperforms other approaches in both accuracy and rapidity.

articleTitle: The New Object-Oriented Teaching Mode Based on Information Technology
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: When the university education from the elite education transition to the popularization of education, when funding for education from the State University of financial assistance to the development of self-financing, the University of industry trends become increasingly evident. University education has gone through a shortage of talent for national culture of the times, and the development of the community to provide education-oriented products and services. The information network has brought a revolution in university education, how to provide better education services related to the development of the University and its future. The object-oriented thinking and service to the community's awareness to the introduction of university education, integrated network of information technology development and industrialization of the University of the trend, the article in the construction of a new model of university education has done an in-depth study and exploration. We have made information technology as the basis, object-oriented thinking as the guide, learning organization at the core of the new teaching mode.

articleTitle: The Research and Teaching Permeated Mutually in Computer-Aid Education
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: At present this thesis provides university students with a constructive measure to resolve a difficult and hot problem during seeking their jobs, takes the finite element method for example through computer-aid education, and makes use of a finite element software to calculate a complicated engineering problem, and makes the result visible. And the thesis clarifies the importance of the teaching and research permeated mutually. The method pays attention to training students' creativity, improving development quality, laying a solid foundation for the following-up course study, graduation design and the engineering design after graduation, and creativity of the research and science, adapt themselves to the need of society.

articleTitle: XConquer: Extended Twig Pattern Matching Based on ftcontains Expression
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: XML employs a tree-structured model for representing data, and queries over XML documents are typically represented as twig patterns. At the same time, keyword search over XML documents has been well studied because of its intuitive and friendly query interface. Consequently, XQuery Full-Text emerges as a full-text extension to XQuery to query both the structure and the text content of XML documents seamlessly. This paper proposes the extended twig pattern matching problem based on the semantics of 'ftcontains' expression in XQFT and develops a novel algorithm, XConquer, for matching an extended twig pattern. Our experimental results show that XConquer offers considerable performance benefits when compared with existing approach variation for this problem.

articleTitle: Research on the Cultivation of Creative and Practical Ability for Engineering Management Students
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: This paper analyzes the educational status of the major in engineering management in Chinese University, points out the deficiency of current educational system for cultivating studentspsila innovative and practical ability. Learning from other countriespsila advanced educational experience, and based on authorspsila experience, the thesis puts forward that IT use in teaching, cooperating with enterprises, training students in practical engineering circumstance and R&D project are effective methods for studentspsila comprehensive ability cultivating.

articleTitle: A Web/CORBA Based Architecture for Network Management with TCP Connection
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: This paper analyzes the shortages of traditional Web/CORBA based network management architecture firstly, and then puts forward a new Web/CORBA based architecture for network management with TCP connection, which applies information push technology and notification service to traditional model. It changes the passive state of server and implements network management in an active state. It can push the trap information to manager actively through the TCP connection established when logging in, so the trap information can be responded and processed in time when it is occurred. The network bandwidth can be saved and the burden of server can be decreased with the architecture. The management efficiency of network is improved greatly.

articleTitle: A Strong Limit Theorem for Functions of Two-Ordered Markov Chains Indexed by a Kind of Non-Homogenous Tree
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: The strong limit theorems is one of the central questions for studying in the international probability theory. The purpose of this paper is to give a strong limit theorem for functions of two-ordered Markov chains indexed by a kind of non-homogenous tree.

articleTitle: Analysis of Certain Methods in Management Science that Aimed to Development Students' Practical Skills and Career Skills
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: The priority of universities and colleges is to develop students' practical capability, creative capability, career capability as well as the capability to initiate a business. As a fundamental course in management major, management science is supposed to have certain features stressing the development of applied talents in the arrangement and design of its educational activities, namely, aimed to improve college studentspsila capabilities in commanding knowledge, utilizing knowledge and fitting in the society. The article emphatically analyzed the methods and approaches of developing students' practical skills and career skills in the coursepsilas teaching process.

articleTitle: A Clustering Analysis Method for Network Traffic Based on Feature Parameter Distribution
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Network traffic analysis needs a lot of data which include much information. Predominating pattern state of traffic true and roundly has been an active and difficult research topic in the field of traffic analysis for many years. Up to now, simplex data analyzed, requirement of high dependence to analyst and the distortion of analyzed result because of some noisy data in the complicated network still make it not perform as well as expected in practice. In view of the situation, this paper proposes the distribution of traffic feature parameters as researching object and making a clustering with an improved algorithm to realize changing tendence and state of traffic. This method is used by making a test with much real data captured by SNMP agent, and the result of experiment indicates that it can eliminate disturbance in the fact of person basically and make a non- supervised analysis furthest. This analysis method is sensitive to changes of traffic pattern and the analysis result is effective with a general real-time requirement.

articleTitle: A Novel Signer-Admission Ring Signature Scheme from Bilinear Pairings
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: In this paper, we presented a novel ring signature scheme in which the actual signer has the ability to admit having signed a document at his will. It's an extension and improvement of the ring signature suggested by Rivest et al. in 2001. This extended ring signature is valuable in real-life application. An actual signer may possibly want to expose himself if he will acquire enormous benefit. Based on bilinear pairings, a novel signer-admission ring signature scheme is presented. It satisfies the properties: anonymity, unforgeability, non-transferable.

articleTitle: Arbitrage Strategy Based on Arbitrage Profitability Index
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Concerning the arbitrage strategies to the multiple-period case, there is still far little research works. In this short note, arbitrage size and arbitrage profitability index (API) for a class of multi-period arbitrages are introduced. Then the arbitrage strategy based on the API is investigated and applied to the treasury bonds arbitrage.

articleTitle: Study on the Performance Evaluation of Agricultural Products Network Marketing Based on Rough Set Theory
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Network marketing is a new marketing approach which may open up a broader market for agricultural products trade, strengthen the links between farmers and the outside world, promote the sales of agricultural products, improve the relationships between farmers and customers, and help farmers analyze market needs to decide the production direction, so it is very important to evaluate the performance of agricultural products network marketing. The paper proposed a performance evaluation model of agricultural products network marketing based on rough set theory. The model used genetic algorithm to reduce the initial decision table and, through calculating the importance of the decision attributes in the reduced decision table, identified the weight coefficients of various influencing indexes, effectively overcoming the subjectivity of weight coefficient determination in the current evaluation models. In the same time, the paper evaluated the network marketing performance of six agricultural enterprises and the results were in line with the actual results, which verified the validity of the proposed evaluation model.

articleTitle: Exploring the Use of Internet in Teaching Business English
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Internet, with its vast source of information and new communication technology, has been embraced as an important tool for language teaching. This paper explores how teachers of Business English, a branch of ESP, may make good use of Internet to facilitate teaching. It first specifies the scope of Business English, and explores the resources online that can be employed to optimize the Business English teaching and learning experience. It also analyzes the principles underlying the application of Internet resources in Business English classroom, highlighting the need to correctly identify the role of Internet resources, to analyze learner needs, to sensibly evaluate online-materials and to integrate on-line resources into the learning process.

articleTitle: Moodle - The Fingertip Art for Carrying out Distance Education
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: The paper discusses six characteristics of moodle to apply in distance education, and then analyzes a specific case to illustrate how to learn through distance education. The significance of this paper is to keep optimizing about moodle application.

articleTitle: A New Method of Cyclic m-Cycle Systems of  Kn,n
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Let K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n,n</sub> denote the complete bipartite graph with n vertices in each part. In this paper, we use difference method to construct the cyclic m-cycle with the short track, and determine necessary and sufficient conditions for the existence of cyclic m-cycle systems of K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n,n</sub> for all integers satisfying the requirements of 30< m les 150 and m equiv 2 (mod 4).

articleTitle: The Structure of EMIF and its Model for Data Exchange and Message Processing
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Among the numerous EMISs (Education Management Information System), the ubiquitous problems such as the difficulties for data sharing and the limited abilities for interoperating make the information systems of different colleges and different departments isolated. Therefore,the committee of Educational Information Technology Standardization (belong to Ministry of Education of China) issued specifications, Education Management Information System Interoperability Framework, which are good solutions for those problems. In this paper, the framework structures and data exchange models as well as the message formate of EMIF are discussed. The systematic analyses for functional demands of a Zone Integration Server (ZIS), the core component of the EMIF, are made, also its functional model is given. The implementation mechanism and algorithm based on message services, message transportation, and message management for the key functions such as message processing are given, and an instance for providing message processing is presented. Finally, the structure for the data interoperation among multi-EMIS on the campus net based on EMIF is discussed.

articleTitle: A Novel Stochastic Programming Formulation for Minimum Energy Cooperative Routing
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: This paper proposed a novel stochastic programming which formulates the minimum energy cost routing for ad hoc wireless network. We presented the stochastic programming formulation to find the minimum energy cooperative routing in slow fading channel and fast fading channel respectively. The analysis shows that the stochastic programming formulation can optimize the minimum energy cost cooperative routing in slow fading channel and approximate the optimum value in fast fading channel preferably.

articleTitle: A Study on the Ability of Educational Technology and Training Model for Elementary and Middle School Teachers
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: The Educational Technology Ability Standard of The Elementary and Middle School Teachers regulates the ability of educational technology that elementary and middle school teachers are supposed to possess from four dimensions: consciousness and attitude,knowledge and skills, application and innovation,social responsibility. The present paper first elaborates the significance and features of The Elementary and Middle School Teacherspsila Educational Technology Ability Standard; it then analyses the two major training models for teacherspsila ability of educational technology: school-based training and normal school students training, emphasizing the difference between educational technology ability training and informational technology training.

articleTitle: Exploration and Practice on the IT Engineering Education Teaching Quality Management and Assurance System of Private Universities Based on ABET
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: This paper examines IT engineering education and attempts to highlight the need for quality management and assurance systems such as the ABET international quality standard system. This will be achieved by focusing on the education practice of the Neusoft Institute of Information (Neusoft II), an institution that has committed in its charter to continuous improvement of personnel training and the creation of a first class IT application-oriented university.

articleTitle: Mining Association Rules in Distributed System
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: This study aims to introduce an algorithm of mining association rules in distributed system based on AprTidRec. The validity of the AprTidRec algorithm is verified by the experiment compared with the Apriori algorithm. Two solutions for the realization of the overall system are presented. One uses the communication mode of local-local to balance the burden of local websites the other uses the mode of local-global to reduce the cost of communication among local websites. The latter realizes the totally asynchrony among local websites but has a strict qualification of the global website.

articleTitle: Manufacturing Enterprise Competitive Strength Analysis and Evaluation System Development
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: From a systematic perspective, the connotation and evaluation of manufacturing enterprise competitive strength are analyzed and studied. Using the AHP method and considering the characteristics of manufacturing enterprises, an indices system for manufacturing enterprise competitive strength evaluation is established based on innovation achievement, productivity, and marketing competitive strength. In the evaluation process, subjective weights are determined through expert investigation method and objective weights are determined through entropy weight method. Then, using no dimensional processing method and convergence processing method, a corresponding evaluation model is established through combining the subjective weights and objective weights. Finally, based on the evaluation model, the comprehensive manufacturing enterprise competitive strength is determined. The evaluation system of enterprise competitive strength analysis and evaluation is developed on Delphi 7 platform and is validated by an instance.

articleTitle: Research on Numerical Implementation and Errors Analysis of Cylindrical Broadband Acoustic Holography
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Broadband acoustic holography based on intensity measurement (BAHIM) is a new technique which is developed for the reconstruction of sources using near-field acoustic holography (NAH). With the sound intensity distribution on a measurement surface, the complex sound pressure phase on the measurement cylinder can be obtained and the complex sound pressure predicted. Applying this method to identify the noise source in underwater cylindrical objects, the principle of the cylindrical interior BAHIM and numerical implementation are presented. In addition, the numerical simulations have been conducted. The influences of the change of parameters are discussed in detail. The merits of the underwater cylindrical interior BAHIM in the reconstruction of sound field, identification and localization of the noise sources are shown clearly in the results.

Author Keywords: underwater identification of the noise sources

articleTitle: The Prediction-Correction and Relaxed Hybrid Steepest-Descent Method for Variational Inequalities
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: This paper proposes a new prediction-correction and relaxed hybrid steepest-descent method for a class of the variational inequality problem with a Lipschitzi and strongly monotone operator on a nonempty closed convex subset in real Hilbert space. In order to improve the computational efficiency, the proposed method integrates the Gauss-Seidel method into the prediction-correction method while taking advantage of some fundamental properties of the real Hilbert space. Finally, strong convergence of this method is proved under suitable assumptions.

articleTitle: The Sub-Health Evaluation Based on the Modern Diagnostic Technique of Traditional Chinese Medicine
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Objective: To evaluate the sub-health based on the modern diagnostic technique of TCM. Method: We draw assistance from diagnostic technique of TCM, use synthesis of the four diagnostic methods, combine the digital and informational diagnostic technique such as the diagnosis of pulse, glossoscopy, the diagnosis of facial complexion, the diagnosis of meridian, and so on, then with the neural network technique to collect the information of sub-health qualitatively and quantitatively, achieve the early diagnosis of sub-health. Result: The modern diagnostic technique of TCM thoroughly absorbs the advantage of diagnostic-technique of TCM with information-collecting precisely and comprehensively, early diagnosis and synchronization of diagnosis and treatment, meanwhile, it uses the modern information technology, overcomes the subjective influence of the evaluation methods nowadays such as scale evaluation, detection evaluation, solves the embarrassed state of modern detection technique in sub-health, establishes the foundation of evaluation system and standard of sub-health. Besides, it successfully avoids the disadvantage of the diagnostic technique of TCM with high expertise require, which is used for clinic. Conclusion: The modern diagnostic technique of TCM achieves the objective, microcosmic, and non-traumatic diagnosis in sub-health, so it has distinct superiority in sub-health evaluation, and we can hope to solve the sub-health problem finally with it.

Author Keywords: The modern diagnostic technique of TCM

articleTitle: Investigation Research of Teacher's Personal Teaching Website
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Teacher's personal teaching website is a practice of modern network teaching. Also itpsilas an experimental field of the future learning society. This paper made an investigation on the present situation of the teacher's teaching websites. By analyzing the status of the personal teaching websites, we proposed some countermeasures of establishing a knowledge-based personalized teaching website.

articleTitle: Microbial Growth Model and Stability Analysis
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Microbial growth is a very complex non-linear system, so there is important engineering significance to study its growth model in holding back biofouling, eliminating biofouling and preventing corrosion. In this paper, a non-linear dynamic model of microbial growth was built based on the theories of the diffusion response of thermodynamics and the chemotactic response of biology. The model involves three variables, the density of bacteria, the concentration of attractant and the pH value. A temporal linear instability is carried out to analyze the stability of the model. The relationship between the growth rate 6 and the wavenumber kappa is expressed by a cubic equation. The results reveal that the stability of three variables does not exist under the conditions involved in present paper.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on the Relationship between China's Education Investment and Economic Growth
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Attention will be focused on education investment on the background of financial crisis. There are theoretical divergences in the studies on the relationship between Chinapsilas education investment and economic growth all along. This paper is based on the time series data from 1978-2007 and Granger causality test is applied to analysis the relationship. The results show that there is a unidirectional causality from Chinapsilas education investment to economic growth. That means increasing Chinapsilas education investment may stimulate economic growth. Naturally, increasing Chinapsilas education investment will be an effective measure to financial crisis.

articleTitle: Research on the General Evaluation of Working Quality of Physical Education Teachers in Universities
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: This article bases on education evaluating theory and uses computers and multi-level evaluation method. It creates a set of evaluation index system and evaluation of mathematical models which can reflect the characteristics of the physical education teachers work in the universities. It provides a scientific assessment and what it provides is very useful.

articleTitle: Research on System Methodology and Cognitive Methods in Computation Subject
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Methodology is the theory of methods in recognizing and reforming the world. It is divided into three layers: philosophy methodology, general science methodology and concrete science methodology. System methodology as one of the basic methods that research computer science, is a general science methodology. This paper aims to discuss the fundamental principles of system methodology, at the same time, emphasizes on the thinking mode and method in computational subject.

articleTitle: Decision Support Systems for Improving Irrigation Scheme Management in Arid Area
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Soil salinization is mainly an arid-zone problem leading to land desertification. It reduces soil quality and limits the growing of crops. The paper mainly aims at the actuality that soil salinization deteriorates in oasis and irrigation scheme management is unreasonable from the point of view that develop irrigation decision support system(DSS) about irrigation area management, and studies the optimal distributing of irrigation water in the irrigation area which take the Yutian oasis demonstration area as an example. The irrigation DSS is developed based on irrigation scheme management scenario which solves the muti-object models and geographic information system (GIS) which support spatial management. The irrigation DSS includes information systems that perform data acquisition, management and visualization, and models that performs simulation and optimization of the irrigation scheme. Multiple, competitive targets and constraints with different priorities can be set. The studying of irrigation DSS in irrigation area will provide scientific decision basis and design scheme for reasonably ascertaining the type of irrigation area and scientific management and optimal allotting of agriculture water resources in the arid area.

articleTitle: The Comparison of Landscape Metrics Derived from Remote Sensing Data before and after Wenchuan Earthquake
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Satellite remote sensing images monitoring before and after the Wenchuan earthquake were becoming of great significance in the field of disaster control and mitigation. This paper compared the landscape metrics derived from remote sensing data before and after Wenchuan earthquake. Firstly, two ASTER imageries acquired before and after earthquake were geo-referenced. Then, the two imageries were segmented and converted into vector files. Finally, six landscape metrics were computed using multi-resolution segmentation vector derived from the two imageries and the computation results before and after earthquake were compared. Comparing results, it concluded that the landscape metrics before and after earthquake are significantly different. After earthquake, the fine surface structure was destroyed due to numerous landslides and rockslides, so Perimeter Area Fractal Dimension and Splitting Index which represents shape complexity decreased. Perimeter Area Fractal Dimension and Splitting Index are more effective indexes to detect the land cover change before and after earthquake.

articleTitle: Implementing SCORM API with WCF and AJAX in Learning Management System
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: This paper describes the design and implementation of SCORM API communication mechanism with WCF and AJAX. The key requirement for this mechanism is to provide a solution to make two existing systems can track integrated learning information. The paper finally created a service oriented SCORM API framework.

articleTitle: A New Chain Verification Signature Scheme
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: With the development of computer and network technology, digital signature techniques are being expanded greatly, from single signature and single verification techniques to multisignature ones. This paper presents a new chain verification signature scheme, which does not grant verifier P<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</sub> to verify the validity of the signature until being authorized by members P<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>, P<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>,......,P<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n-1</sub> of the chain verification authority group. Besides the ordinary properties of chain verification signature, the proposed scheme can easily add or delete authorizers of chain verification. Furthermore, the scheme can be protected in time when sub-secrets were leaked by verifiers or authorizers. In addition, the security and efficiency of the proposed scheme was analyzed.

articleTitle: Research on Task Assignment Algorithm of Mobile Learning System for Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Sensor networks have recently gained a lot of attention from the research community. Energy cost is an important constraint in task assignment of wireless sensor network (WSN). Sensor networks typically have a large number of nodes. To ensure scalability sensor networks are often partitioned into clusters, each managed by a cluster head (gateway). Tasks need to be allocated to gateways in such a way that maximizes the life of these cluster heads and eventually the whole network. In our work, we present an optimization scheme for task assignment to gateways. Simulation results show that energy savings can be obtained with the proposed method. In our mobile learning system about Chinese learning for foreign students, it would show a good implement on Energy-efficient.

articleTitle: A Survey on the English Learning Strategy of the Rural High School Students
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: This paper aims to investigate the overall characteristics of the rural high school studentspsila learning strategy selection and use. The results indicate that the general frequency of the subjectspsila learning strategies selection and use is not satisfying. Among the six learning strategies, the most used strategies are affective strategies, and the least used strategies by the subjects are social strategies.

articleTitle: Reflections and Reconstruction of the Culture of Scientific Research Works in Local Institutions of Higher Learning
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: The culture of scientific research acts as an integrated part of the organization culture. In local institutions of higher learning, the research culture shall basically feature scientificalness, advancement, innovativeness as well as humanism. However, during the process of development of research culture, such problems as insufficient understanding of the whole, lacking of institutional construction and ignorance of the spiritual culture etc. are quite common in many local colleges and universities. In order to conduct reconstruction of the scientific research culture, we shall make every effort to take the spiritual culture as the core, to strengthen environmental construction, to foster scientific spirit and team spirit while adhering to the people-oriented theory and to pay attention to humanistic care so as to enhance social responsibility.

articleTitle: Credibility Assessment of Simulation Test for Antiaircraft Missile
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: A full building flow of simulation model was analyzed aiming at assessing credibility problem of simulation test for antiaircraft missile, and the works on credibility assessment of simulation within full life cycle such as concept model, data assessment, simulation model, simulation method etc. were presented. Based on the given condition and index of credibility assessment, consistency check methods for flight result and simulation result were researched, that is, according to the difference of output data, time domain method or frequency domain method is used to continuous variable, and rank sum check method to static performance parameter. It can be seen from assessing credibility of a type of missile trajectory simulation system that above-mentioned methods are feasible, effective, and practical.

articleTitle: The Research of Network Quality Courses Evaluation System Based on Feedback
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: In view of the construction of quality courses for network instruction, one of the essential questions is how to evaluate the quality courses website whether to suit the learners. This article proposes a new method, gives every learning-content page and testing exercise a serial number, which causes the collection and reorganization of data becoming easy. At the same time, the relation between behavior and achievement of learners can be feedback accurately through the way of questionnaire survey and network test. Finally, the instruction design of quality courses website will meet the demand of e-learning more.

articleTitle: Accurate Calculation Approach for Auto-Estimation on Anisotropic and Sporadic Small Area
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: This paper proposes a statistical estimation approach for the sporadic especially antitropic shapes of the source picture. In the field of GIS, the application such as the estimation of the green coverage rate in established districts will need the aid of the area estimation approach. Series of statistical estimation approaches have been put forward for different geographical regions, such as mountainous, open, and forested areas. However, no effective method has been found to function well on sporadic and antitropic regions.In this condition, the error brought out by the border of the sporadic and antitropic regions cannot be neglected,or the accumulation of these errors will come to be considerable. We propose an approach which will bring out no error in the calculation process. Our approach includes the two parts-shape dividing and area integral.The time cost of the shape dividing algorism is lower than the existing algorism in our condition. The adaptation of the integral approach based on the result of the shape dividing algorism can guarantee the accuracy of the statistical estimation result.

articleTitle: On the Effects of Micro-Incentive Mechanism to Quality of Teaching in University
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: The paper researches the structures of micro-incentive mechanism in teaching management, and puts forward two key elements of measuring micro-incentive mechanism, namely measuring quantitative and price of teaching activity, and then we provide some typical examples of micro-incentive mechanism and study the effects to teaching quality of different choices, and we also give some proxies of utilities of the schools, teachers and students, and analyze utility relationships of schools, students and teachers by empirical methods under different micro-incentive mechanisms, and give some important references to make micro-incentive mechanism by managers.

articleTitle: Practice and Research on the Construction of Model Course College Computer in Teachers' Colleges
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: According to the new white paper from the Ministry of Education, considering teacher educationpsilas special requirement for the computer skills, based on the current situation of the first year studentspsila computer knowledge, we made a series of reform on the teaching of College Computer. Focused on the construction of model course College Computer, we designed a new teaching model for College Computer in teacherspsila colleges which will put the computer education throughout the college education. The corresponding systems such as ldquothe computer-assisted teaching systemrdquo, ldquothe computer testing systemrdquo and ldquothe functional network teaching platformrdquo and so on are developed.

articleTitle: A Study on Attribution Characteristics of Math Major Students in Intercourse Scope
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Taking the math major students as the subjects, this paper discussed the causal attribution characteristics of success or failure in social intercourse, their expectation changing and emotional reaction. The paper found that: (1) the intercourse results are varied among the students which they attribute to different casual cognitions, no significant differences in grades or genders, but significant in success or failure; (2) no significant differences in expectation, and students all willing to put great efforts to get a better result; (3) they feel excited and happy after success, while feel frustrated and inferior even display stronger emotional reactions after failure.

articleTitle: How to Cultivate Student's Memory
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: In this paper, the author demonstrates the significance of cultivating student’s memory firstly; and then put forward memory methods, including the method of reciting, the teaching method of understanding, the method of repeating, the method of associating, the method of amusing; the method of applying.

articleTitle: Research on the Present Utilization of Multimedia - CAI in University PE Teaching
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Through some procedures, such as the questionnaire survey, documents collecting and scientific analysis, the present utilization of multimedia - CAI in university PE teaching is investigated and studied in this paper. The paper launches the elaboration in the perspectives of gym instructorspsila understanding, utilization and making of multimedia; and it explores education patterns adapted to the request of information age development. The paper proposes that the auxiliary functions of CAI in PE teaching should be fully displayed, and at the same time society and universities should strengthen teachers for the construction of CAI in order to provide economic and technical support, guarantee the ideal optimization of teaching effects and accelerate constant development of university PE.

articleTitle: A Personnel Classification Model Based on Reducing Cost and Avoiding Risks
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Most enterprises face the challenge to reduce personnel cost, since enterprises spend a lot of money on it. This paper studies the classifying method of personnel with the purpose to minimize the cost and avoid risk. It presents an evaluation classifying approach based on integration of quantitative models with subjective evaluation for the classification. At last the AS Corporationpsilas case demonstrates that the method is feasible.

articleTitle: The Research of the Remote Network Learning Performance Based on the Performance Technology
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Distance-learning network has now become an important way for majority of teachers to teach graduate students, and the study of the network has also been concerned about the learning performance not the learning process. This paper, the authors choose the network course "network application in education" as an actual case, by analyzing the data of the status of network, they provide a number of performance interventions about how to improve network performance.

articleTitle: Three-Dimensional Reconstruction and Evaluation Based on CT Images
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Two-dimensional Computed Tomography (CT) images are not enough for further analysis. Only the points with the same Z coordinates can be measured on the two-dimensional images, and the points on the different layers can not be measured. In order to promote the development of the industrial CT, the three-dimensional reconstruction and analysis system is researched in this paper. The three-dimensional reconstruction system is based on the sequence of the two-dimensional images. Firstly, the edges acquired after threshold segmentation should be found in each image. Secondly, the corresponding edges describing the same surface should be found in the different images. Thirdly, the corresponding points on the corresponding edges should be found according to their similarity. After all the points are found, the contours in the different images can be connected. The three-dimensional reconstruction system provides move, rotation, and zoom tools, so it can give more vivid view for the operators. It seems as if the real object was shown in the computer. The analysis system is based on the three-dimensional reconstruction system; it includes some useful functions, such as distance measurement, angle measurement, volume measurement, cut and installation of a part, peeling off layer after layer, etc. Any points on the images can be measured. All these functions can help the operators to study the object more conveniently. After 50 times measurement of two selected points, the average measurement precision can reach to 0.0007mm. From a lot of experiments, the three-dimensional CT system is proved that it is more vivid, reliable, convenient, and useful. And it can be extended to any non-destructive tomography technology, such as Optical Coherence Tomography (OCT), Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), single photoemissions computed tomography (SPECT), positron emission tomography (PET), etc.

articleTitle: Preliminary Study on College Physics Chromaticity Measurement Experiment Activity Design Based on M-learning
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: M-learning, another new learning model following digital learning is a new hot spot in the research domain of educational technology. As a new branch of e-learning, it has increasingly brought peoplepsilas attention. How to support learning and teaching with wireless technology and mobile equipments have become the focus of research of M-learning. This year (2008) the author try to melt M-Learning into college physics experiment course, the student's learning enthusiasm are warm enhanced, the preliminary reflection looks well. In this paper, it explains the concept and the application model of M-learning, in combination with the experience gained from the college physics experiment teaching reform and practice. With brief discuss and analysis on the design idea and implementation process of college physics chromaticity measurement experiment activity based on M-learning. The author conclude that, blending traditional teaching model with M-learning is effective. We should research new learning style and model of M-learning, to promote the development of education.

articleTitle: Design of a Hardware-in the Loop Experiment Simulation System for Process Control Based on RTW
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Based on the study of MATLAB/RTW function,a hardware-in the loop experiment simulation system is designed. In this platform, data transmission between practical process and MATLAB workshop was carried out by an I/O card supported by MATLAB, so that the practical system was imported to the simulation loop, the integration of system modelling, analysis, digital simulation and goal realization is realized. The teaching and research contents, just as automatic control technology, detecting element, actuating mechanism, controlled object and so on can be merged into one integral whole based on this platform, comprehensive experimenst can be establish. In the end, an experiment taking the electric cup as the controlled object based on fuzzy control method is fulfilled. The simulation result shows that the system has good real-time performance, parameters can be modified on online .The platform can be widely used in control theory experimental teaching or control system design.

articleTitle: An Authentication Scheme for VQ-Compressed Images
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Some data hiding schemes for VQ-compressed images are based on index modifications. These may cause many distortions between host images and watermarked images, so they are not suitable for authentication of VQ-compressed images. In this paper, we propose a new image authentication scheme for VQ-compressed images. This scheme utilizes an information hiding method based on covering codes. It only modifies few indices slightly to conceal authentication information. Moreover, the proposed scheme is quite simple and secret, and can detect any modifications of VQ-compressed images. Theoretical analysis and experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of this scheme.

articleTitle: Gray-Level Image Segmentation Based on Markov Chain Monte Carlo
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: A new method called Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) is proposed for image segmentation. The MCMC method mainly contains three aspects. Firstly, the image segmentation problem is formulated in a Bayesian statistical framework. Four types of gray-level image models are set up. Secondly, the solution space is decomposed into a union of many subspaces. Thirdly, ergodic Markov chains are designed to explore the solution space and sample the posterior probability. We test the MCMC algorithm on a wide variety of gray-level images and some results are shown in the paper.

articleTitle: Study of Snow Disaster Loss Evaluation Model Based on Projection Pursuit
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: It is a complex problem of multi-attribute and multi-factor to evaluate snow disaster loss. In order to resolve the non-uniformity problem of evaluation results of disaster loss indices, and to raise the evaluation result precision of snow disaster loss, this paper proposes a snow disaster loss evaluation model based on projection pursuit (PP). Accordingly, the paper converts high dimensional indices data to projection value of single dimension by PP which can find optimal projection direction using accelerating genetic algorithm (AGA). A scheme of PP modeling is also presented to reduce the computational amount, and a new function of projection indices is given. It is suggested that both the function of projection indices and the parameters of PP model can be optimized by using a real coding based accelerating genetic algorithm. Furthermore, the case study shows that the model has the advantage of simplicity and objectiveness of the evaluation result.

articleTitle: E-Learning Aided Teaching Mode of Engineering Curricula Based on Agent
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Aimed at overcoming the shortcoming of the traditional teaching mode in Chinese universities, improving the status quo that the engineering courses are difficult to be understood and the students had fewer opportunities to contact the actual objects, the agent-based e-Learning aided teaching mode of engineering courses is brought forwards based on the requirements of persons with innovative ability in future world and the development of computer and network technologies. The core technologies of E-learning concept are applied in this teaching mode. By using this mode, the traditional teacher-centered teaching mode will be tried to transfer to the student-centered self-study model. By using the agent technology, it is achieved the share of knowledge and studying methods, the multimedia teaching methods and the maintenance of knowledge and E-learning system itself. It has provided a new thought for the college education of China.

articleTitle: The Research and Practice of Training Plans and Curriculums on Mechanical Professionals in Higher Technical and Vocational College
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: The paper is aiming at the current situation that mechanical professionals in higher technical and vocational college were lacking in ability to engineering practice and application. Firstly, a point to position mechanical-application college education as adapting to regional economic development was advanced. So the basic characteristics of the new training mode and educational system for the applied talents were determined. Furthermore, in order to train professional ability, professional course system was constructed and the training process, ways, methods and means was also explored. It was proved by practice that its role and effect of the training plan and system was obvious.

articleTitle: Survivability of Network Information System: An Overview
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Society has become so dependent on information systems that provide the information underpinnings for critical infrastructure applications. With the development of network technology, these systems continue to emerge and grow, and have become unbounded networked systems that are highly distributed. But traditional security technology is not sufficient to deal with the protection and survivability of highly distributed information systems operating in unbounded networks. Survivability research is the key to resolve the problem. This paper organizes and summarizes the current literatures and presents an overview of survivability research by discussing the definition, the various techniques and the estimate models of survivability, and finally, presents a conclusion and future work.

articleTitle: Integrating Strategies for Keyword Querying across Heterogeneous Databases
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Result integrating is a key component for keyword querying across heterogeneous databases. Once the results from various search engines are collected, the search engine merges them into a single ranked list. In this paper, firstly, we present a novel model of searching, which the database is an undirected graph and results are modeled as answer trees that match individual keywords in the query. Secondly, we propose the query translator and algorithm to process most queries with complicate Boolean semantics including AND, OR, NOT and their combinations. Thirdly, we propose a multi-level caching method, which integrated results are assigned to store cache to form top-k sorting, and the final results are generated. Experiments show that the proposed integrating strategy provides significant performance benefits.

articleTitle: Design of Distance Teaching Platform Based on Quality Assurance Standard - Taking Learning Management Platform for Tuition Free Normal College Student as an Example
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Emerging concerns about quality of e-learning products and services animated a project in many countries to establish and implement quality assurance. The paper introduces the international standard of quality management, assurance and metrics for information technology learning, education, and training which is put forward by technical committee ISO/IEC JTC1 SC36. With the implementation of tuition-free normal college studentspsila education in Huazhong Normal University, this paper describes how to use the quality assurance standard to establish a learning management platform for tuition-free normal college students in Huazhong Normal University. According to Reference Framework for Quality Descriptions (RFDQ) of the quality assurance standard, needs analysis and framework analysis of the platform are conducted by way of interview and investigation, and subsequently detailed functional design of the platform is implemented. Finally, the author explores the quality assurance of the platform.

articleTitle: A Chinese Word Segmentation Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Different from English, there are no interval marks between words in Chinese. Segmenting Chinese text to words is the first job for every kind of Chinese information processing, so Chinese word segmentation is a basal and difficult issue in the field of Chinese information processing. Traditional word segmentation systems have to establish the dictionary and add unknown words out of the dictionary with manual work. This paper proposes a new Chinese word segmentation model which can automatically establish a dictionary, gradually update it and perfect it based on machine learning. Four modules of the machine learning model for Chinese word segmentation system are introduced in detail and some improvements of the algorithms are made on some module to improve system performance. After the test of closed corpus and open corpus, the results show that the method alleviates the workload of building and maintaining the dictionary, furthermore, it resolves the issues of ambiguity processing and unknown words recognition.

articleTitle: Bilateral Web-Based Collaborative Learning in the Transnational Higher Education
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: In the process of higher education internationalization, information technology and network have been applied to increase the foreign contacts. In recent years, Web-based collaborative learning (WBCL) has aroused peoplespsila interest by its unique superiority in facilitating the interactive learning. This paper focuses on the WBCL application in transnational education context, and a bilateral WBCL model of transnational programs is proposed. To demonstrate the performance of WBCL in transnational programs, an in-depth analysis is made on the case of a Sino-Canada cooperative education program. The program has applied the Web-based educational technologies into teaching the course of stock market simulation, which involves the students and faculties in different locations of both China and Canada into a virtual transnational learning environment. Through the interactive instructional methods, Chinese students are exposed to different economic, political, and multi-cultural issues and values of their Canadian classmates. And the statistic data shows that they have achieved better outcomes in the collaborative learning environment.

articleTitle: Infrared Image Simulation of Building Scene Based on SVM
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Real-time infrared image simulation of building scene based on support vector machine (SVM) is presented. The parameters that influence object surface temperature field are analyzed and set as the input vector of SVM, the temperatures of object surface apartments are got by infrared imaging temperature measurement and set as output target of SVM. After training the learning machines by the training samples which consist of input vector and target set, support vector machines have the ability to forecast the temperature field with simulation parameters. Real-time rendering of building scene infrared images is realized by three-dimension visualization. The result shows this method has a quality of maneuverability, and high simulation precision.

articleTitle: What are Roles of Stimulus Situation and Material Type in Short-term Memory Encoding?: A Signal Detection Theory Approach
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: The experiment used signal detection theory to study the way information encoded in the short-term memory, taking Chinese character and English word as materials. The results of the experiment showed that the subjects could choose different ways of encoding flexibly, according to variable stimulus situations. Acoustic code was found may be the main encoding mode in this experiment. Yet the experiment got another result that the discrimination of Chinese character is higher than that of English, and difference between them is significant, which is likely to be caused by the influence of the subjects' mother tongue.

articleTitle: An Analysis of 100-Meter Race Athletes' Score Range Based on the Grey System Theory
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: This paper applies the grey system theory on the correlated quantificational analysis of the first-class 100-meter runnerpsilas score range, demonstrating the internal connection between some disordered data and coming to the finding of the sequential characters of these runnerpsilas range scores, which place influences upon Manpsilas 100-meter race. Then it concludes with the point of specially treated range training mode, which has a great significance for the training of Manpsilas 100-meter race.

articleTitle: To Research the Design of the Middleware System for Active Database Inquiry
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: Researching the middleware-system structure, the system explores the possibility of adding Active Inquiry Mechanism to the Relationship Database which had none or has a less-active function. By adding an interface between the Relationship Database Management System (RDBMS) and the application, the system provides an Active Mechanism to the RDBMS to make it capable of active trigger. This system has also provided an active database system to the Relationship Database System in order for the user to apply their familiar database product while enjoying the superior capability of the active mechanism. The essay is focusing on the discussion of the Middleware Module of active database and the technique to achieve it.

articleTitle: Clock Synchronization in Distributed Real-Time Simulation System
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: We present an improved algorithm to get high precision clock synchronization. In this algorithm, the initial synchronous deviation and the uncertainty of synchronization network are eliminated. Based on the underlying hardware clock, we achieve high resolution logic clock, so it supplies the practice base for this algorithm. This solution can get higher precision than the previous algorithm under the same circumstance.

articleTitle: The Research on Parallel Algorithm of A-order in Binary Tree Based on PRAM Model
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: In this paper, the problem of A-order of binary tree is studied with the PRAM(Parallel Random Access Machine) model of parallel computation and a parallel algorithm for A-order of binary tree is proposed. The process of the parallel algorithm is proceed with detailed description and verified analysis with an application instance. The parallel algorithm of A-order of binary tree provides using and reference for applying it to binary tree traverse sequence and solving the parallelism problem of application program.

articleTitle: Discussion of Computer Basis Education Reform and Innovation in Colleges and Universities
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: With the world coming into the information age, computer basis course has become the public basic course which must be set up in colleges and universities and the increasing popularization of computers makes the computer basis education in university facing with more and more higher request. Combined with specific actual teaching, this paper pointed out some problems faced by the current computer basis teaching, and discussed how to use modern means in aspects of teaching force, teaching mode, teaching content and teaching objectives and so on to improve the quality and effect of teaching and cultivate studentpsilas integrated capabilities, and how to take bold innovation and incessant reforms in teaching.

articleTitle: Workflow-Based ERP Research in Automobile Refitting Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
abstract: This article summarizes four types of workflow modeling. There are object-oriented, role-oriented, activity oriented and language-oriented. Order process model is extracted from automobile refitting enterprise and activity oriented approach is applied to establish workflow based on the model. Organization model is proposed in the enterprise. ERP system model is established based on order workflow, organization model and RBAC. The whole design process of ERP software is discussed in detail. Application shows that workflow-based ERP is totally suitable to the enterprise.

articleTitle: Study on Vibration of Drill String in Straight Wells by ANSYS
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
